0273ce3aff09.en: With sulking lips, Eori now started to portion the jelly into glass containers, carefully letting equal amounts of Harry’s meat into each nari gel jar. “Fucking retarded!” She stated in a somewhat aggressive tone, corking one portion of the nari gel with a loud hand stomp on the cork, then holding it up towards Harry. “I’m a fucking scientist! You’re my Soreno to experiment on! What you see is the final product.”
0273ce3aff09.t: Dengan bibir merajuk, Eori kini mula membahagikan jeli itu ke dalam bekas-bekas kaca, dengan berhati-hati memasukkan jumlah daging Harry yang sama ke dalam setiap balang nari gel. “Terencat celaka!” Dia berkata dengan nada yang agak agresif, menutup satu bahagian nari gel dengan hentakan tangan yang kuat pada gabusnya, kemudian mengangkatnya ke arah Harry. “Aku saintis, celaka! Kau Soreno aku untuk dieksperimen! Apa yang kau nampak ni produk akhirnya.”

049dd0356a1b.en: “I SAID SHUT THE FUCK UP!” She bashed the journal in her hand against one of the mixing bowls towards Harry, making it fall on the ground with a big wet slop sound, while the metallic bowl kept ringing against the hard floor until it stopped kicking around. Eori looked at her mess, sighing heavily. “You know? Fuck it. Let’s go to the next variant in the queue.” She picked up a massive syringe from a bowl and approached Harry with it in full display.
049dd0356a1b.t: “AKU KATA DIAM, CELAKA!” Dia menghentak jurnal di tangannya ke salah satu mangkuk adunan ke arah Harry, membuatkannya jatuh ke lantai dengan bunyi lecak basah yang kuat, sementara mangkuk logam itu terus berdenting di lantai keras sehingga ia berhenti bergolek. Eori memandang sepahnya, mengeluh berat. “Kau tahu? Lantaklah. Jom kita pergi ke varian seterusnya dalam giliran.” Dia mengambil picagari besar dari sebuah mangkuk dan mendekati Harry dengannya dipamerkan sepenuhnya.

0604cc53c91e.en: Taking a deep breath after another huge gulp, Harry felt a warm, fuzzy feeling in his esophagus slowly running down towards his stomach. This feeling began to spread in his innards, radiating through his body, somehow making his wounds feel even more itching and hot. He flinched and squirmed around like a coked-out addict wanting his fix. His head kept swinging around while his tied arms and legs twitched, trying to escape this horrible torture akin to being tied down and furiously tickled by hundreds of feathers. His mind would do anything and give up everything to make it stop—even a chance to escape this basement if it came to it.
0604cc53c91e.t: Menarik nafas dalam selepas satu lagi teguk besar, Harry merasakan perasaan hangat yang kabur di esofagusnya perlahan-lahan mengalir turun ke perutnya. Perasaan ini mula merebak dalam isi perutnya, memancar ke seluruh tubuhnya, entah bagaimana membuatkan luka-lukanya terasa lebih gatal dan panas. Dia tersentak dan menggeliat seperti penagih kokain yang mahukan dosnya. Kepalanya terus berayun sementara lengan dan kakinya yang terikat kejang, cuba melarikan diri dari seksaan ngeri ini yang seperti diikat dan digeletek dengan kuat oleh ratusan bulu. Fikirannya sanggup melakukan apa sahaja dan melepaskan segala-galanya untuk menghentikannya—malah peluang untuk melarikan diri dari bilik bawah tanah ini jika sampai ke tahap itu.

0c2a5a21e9aa.en: “Nope!” Eori’s vicious grin was now forming from ear to ear, picking up the mixing bowl and laying it down at the bottom of his feet. “It will taint the nari gel!”
0c2a5a21e9aa.t: “Tak boleh!” Sengihan ganas Eori kini terbentuk dari telinga ke telinga, mengambil mangkuk adunan dan meletakkannya di bawah kakinya. “Nanti ia cemarkan nari gel!”

0dd8ba40c43e.en: Harry, with his blurry eyes, saw Eori quickly close the door, then he heard it being locked. Rushed footsteps followed after going down the stairs. Alone in this tiny bathroom with a slanted roof, he looked out from the window up top, but his blurry eyes saw nothing but unknown forests. In the far distance, he saw what appeared to be a smokestack coming off a chimney or a small forest fire—there was no way he could tell.
0dd8ba40c43e.t: Harry, dengan matanya yang kabur, melihat Eori cepat-cepat menutup pintu, kemudian dia mendengarnya dikunci. Langkah tergesa-gesa menyusul turun tangga. Bersendirian di bilik air kecil berbumbung condong ini, dia memandang keluar dari tingkap di atas, tetapi matanya yang kabur tidak nampak apa-apa selain hutan yang tidak dikenali. Di kejauhan, dia nampak sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti asap dari cerobong atau kebakaran hutan kecil—tiada cara untuk dia pastikan.

0f2819aaf98c.en: Harry felt a piercing pressure pain deep in his head as Eori fingers raped his eye socket. Next was an acute, pinching pressure that rocketed itself from the socket and deeper into his brain. His other eye opened, and he saw his own deflated eyeball in Eori’s hand with a stringy white thing in her hand. His body shivered as the ambient cold air was seeping into his brain. The abusive pain, terror, and shock began to morph into warmth and numbness he felt over the rest of his body. Harry could feel the sweet relief of death approaching him once again, letting him escape away from this miserable room.
0f2819aaf98c.t: Harry merasakan kesakitan tekanan yang menusuk jauh di dalam kepalanya ketika jari Eori merogol soket matanya. Seterusnya ialah tekanan tajam yang mencubit yang melonjak dari soket dan lebih dalam ke otaknya. Matanya yang lagi satu terbuka, dan dia melihat biji matanya sendiri yang kempis di tangan Eori dengan benda putih berserat di tangannya. Tubuhnya menggigil ketika udara sejuk sekeliling meresap ke dalam otaknya. Kesakitan penderaan, ketakutan dan kejutan mula berubah menjadi kehangatan dan kebas yang dirasainya di seluruh baki tubuhnya. Harry dapat merasakan kelegaan manis kematian menghampirinya sekali lagi, membiarkannya melarikan diri dari bilik yang menyedihkan ini.

0fa6ccbc5fbc.en: Harry felt a hot-bothered itching deep in his chest exploding through his body. The sensation started accumulating and grew more intense in his wounds. His right eye itched so much that he would rather have it scooped out again than deal with it. The sweet relief of death unbinding him from this plane seemed to be reversed—he felt as if he was no longer sinking in an ocean of darkness, but rather a force was pulling him towards the bright surface even though he didn’t want to.
0fa6ccbc5fbc.t: Harry merasakan rasa gatal yang panas dan mengganggu jauh di dalam dadanya meletup ke seluruh tubuhnya. Sensasi itu mula terkumpul dan menjadi lebih kuat di luka-lukanya. Mata kanannya begitu gatal sehingga dia lebih rela ia dikorek keluar lagi daripada menghadapinya. Kelegaan manis kematian yang melepaskannya dari alam ini seakan-akan diterbalikkan—dia merasakan seolah-olah dia tidak lagi tenggelam dalam lautan kegelapan, sebaliknya satu kuasa menariknya ke arah permukaan yang terang walaupun dia tidak mahu.

16a5948ebbd7.en: Harry heard Eori’s words echo in his head, sounding like she was further away as his blurry eyes grew even blurrier. Wanna—go—home. He could nearly feel his soul detaching from his body, leaving this shitty physical realm behind.
16a5948ebbd7.t: Harry mendengar kata-kata Eori bergema dalam kepalanya, kedengaran seperti dia semakin jauh ketika matanya yang kabur menjadi lebih kabur. Nak—balik—rumah. Dia hampir dapat merasakan jiwanya terlerai dari tubuhnya, meninggalkan alam fizikal yang celaka ini.

193accd94e60.en: With a vicious smile, Eori seemed to grow optimistic again, even appearing to ignore the mess she created. She precisely squeezed the syringe, letting just a bit of the reddish concoction out of the tip of the needle.
193accd94e60.t: Dengan senyuman ganas, Eori kelihatan menjadi optimistik semula, malah kelihatan tidak mengendahkan sepah yang dibuatnya. Dia memicit picagari itu dengan tepat, membiarkan sedikit campuran kemerahan keluar dari hujung jarum.

1e3456cc9931.en: “So—so—you’re a harvester?” Harry spoke inwards, his body almost flinching, expecting Eori to flip her shit and throw a glass bottle at him for his supposed probing questions.
1e3456cc9931.t: “Jadi—jadi—awak penuai?” Harry bercakap ke dalam, tubuhnya hampir tersentak, menjangkakan Eori akan mengamuk dan membaling botol kaca kepadanya kerana soalannya yang disangka menyiasat.

1e6e856ba5fb.en: The muscles in his neck began to cave under the weight of his head, making it fall forward. Harry wet his dried lips, holding back his growling stomach as the thought of the food he had at Sanbi Castle came to mind. Harry could almost taste the purple-meat sausage on his dry, raspy tongue; the burst of chicken flavor, specifically from dark meat mixed with bone marrow, made him salivate a slaty sliver of thicker spit. His stomach rumbled even more when he remembered that the fat within the sausage balanced the other spices out to create this smooth meaty goodness palate.
1e6e856ba5fb.t: Otot-otot di lehernya mula mengalah di bawah berat kepalanya, membuatkannya jatuh ke depan. Harry membasahkan bibirnya yang kering, menahan perutnya yang berkeroncong ketika teringat makanan yang dimakannya di Istana Sanbi. Harry hampir dapat merasa sosej daging ungu di lidahnya yang kering dan kasar; letupan rasa ayam, khususnya dari daging gelap bercampur sumsum tulang, membuatkannya meleleh secalit air liur masin yang lebih pekat. Perutnya lebih berkeroncong apabila dia teringat bahawa lemak di dalam sosej itu mengimbangi rempah-rempah lain untuk mencipta rasa daging yang licin dan enak.

20f912232435.en: “DON’T FUCKING PUKE ON ME!” Eori pushed Harry’s head out of her way.
20f912232435.t: “JANGAN MUNTAH ATAS AKU, CELAKA!” Eori menolak kepala Harry dari laluannya.

214bdd1e860b.en: Eori continued slicing Harry’s meat, including one that looked rather spongy and phallic. They all fell prey to the knife without exception. In between precisely cutting chunks of meat, Eori glanced towards Harry, seeing him tightly clenching his entire face, screaming more through his nose as his flesh healed up in mere seconds. With a crisp nod and a developing vicious smile, her lips began forming words, “Not bad.”
214bdd1e860b.t: Eori terus menghiris daging Harry, termasuk satu yang kelihatan agak berspan dan berbentuk falus. Semuanya menjadi mangsa pisau tanpa pengecualian. Di antara memotong ketulan daging dengan tepat, Eori mengerling ke arah Harry, melihatnya mengetatkan seluruh wajahnya, menjerit lebih banyak melalui hidungnya sementara dagingnya sembuh dalam beberapa saat sahaja. Dengan anggukan yang tegas dan senyuman ganas yang mula terbentuk, bibirnya mula membentuk perkataan, “Boleh tahan.”

21fc2f8cf285.en: In Harry’s mind, a fear of that razor gouging his neck kept him silent. I guess all I can do now is not piss her off.
21fc2f8cf285.t: Dalam fikiran Harry, ketakutan pisau cukur itu mengorek lehernya membuatkannya diam. Rasanya yang aku boleh buat sekarang cuma jangan buat dia marah.

289e29b64ed4.en: Harry’s right eye began to emerge from the darkness within his eye socket, feeling tender—like when you get sand in your eyes. In his vision, he saw a shower of stars that was so bright it looked like he was staring at fireworks blowing up in front of his face. He tilted his head back as the feeling grew more intense, right before his center vision began returning to him, expanding outwards to bring his peripheral vision back on line. During that healing process, he could see it clear as day for a few seconds as his right eye grew—just enough to see Eori slicing open one of his testicles. Immediately looking down at his wounds, his brain assumed the worst, but they were all gone, and his lower, floppier member was there again, still growing. Only blood remnants dirtying his skin were proof that it all had happened. With a heavy sigh, he spoke with a brittle quiet tone, “I’m sorry! Please—just let me—just let me die!” A handful of salty tears came running down his face. “I’M SORRY!” A sobbing arose from deep within, but not many tears came out.
289e29b64ed4.t: Mata kanan Harry mula muncul dari kegelapan di dalam soket matanya, terasa lembut sakitnya—seperti ketika pasir masuk ke mata. Dalam penglihatannya, dia melihat hujan bintang yang begitu terang sehingga kelihatan seperti dia merenung bunga api meletup di depan mukanya. Dia mendongakkan kepalanya ketika perasaan itu menjadi lebih kuat, sebelum penglihatan tengahnya mula kembali kepadanya, meluas ke luar untuk mengembalikan penglihatan pinggirnya. Semasa proses penyembuhan itu, dia dapat melihat dengan jelas seperti siang hari selama beberapa saat ketika mata kanannya tumbuh—cukup untuk melihat Eori menghiris terbuka salah satu buah zakarnya. Serta-merta memandang ke bawah ke luka-lukanya, otaknya menyangka yang paling teruk, tetapi semuanya sudah hilang, dan anggotanya yang lebih rendah dan lebih lembik ada di situ semula, masih tumbuh. Hanya sisa darah yang mengotorkan kulitnya menjadi bukti bahawa semuanya telah berlaku. Dengan keluhan berat, dia bercakap dengan nada perlahan yang rapuh, “Maaf! Tolong—biar je saya—biar je saya mati!” Segelintir air mata masin mengalir di wajahnya. “SAYA MINTA MAAF!” Esakan timbul dari dalam, tetapi tidak banyak air mata yang keluar.

2962a781a01a.en: With a shallow laugh, Eori stood there, watching Harry play with his hands like a school kid who watched far too much shonen. “Are you that stupid? You tap the sigil ring on the other palm while laying the fingers flat, then clench the fingers to start the spell.”
2962a781a01a.t: Dengan ketawa cetek, Eori berdiri di situ, memerhati Harry bermain dengan tangannya seperti budak sekolah yang menonton terlalu banyak shonen. “Kau bodoh sangat ke? Kau ketuk cincin sigil tu pada tapak tangan lagi satu sambil jari rata, lepas tu kepal jari untuk mulakan jampi.”

2b1bd676bc90.en: “I’m sorry—I’m sorry!” Harry said in a trembling tone, unable to even look at long-haired Harry as he began expecting the worst to happen next.
2b1bd676bc90.t: “Maaf—maaf!” Harry berkata dengan nada menggeletar, tidak mampu memandang Harry berambut panjang pun kerana dia mula menjangkakan yang paling teruk akan berlaku seterusnya.

2c13e279a59e.en: Eori laid the winga feather to rest, then curled her hair with her finger. “What colors did the dice land in the duel with Maiara?”
2c13e279a59e.t: Eori meletakkan bulu winga itu, kemudian memintal rambutnya dengan jari. “Warna apa dadu tu mendarat dalam pertarungan dengan Maiara?”

2cf6a6ecc723.en: “I’m sorry! I’m sorry!” Harry recoiled, grinning his teeth as he saw Eori putting a long, skinny wood thing into the other T-shaped thing she was holding. His blurry eyes couldn’t quite figure it out.
2cf6a6ecc723.t: “Maaf! Maaf!” Harry tersentak, mengetap giginya ketika melihat Eori memasukkan benda kayu yang panjang dan kurus ke dalam benda berbentuk T yang lagi satu yang dipegangnya. Matanya yang kabur tidak dapat memahaminya dengan jelas.

2e5399d24966.en: A piercing cold pain invaded Harry’s belly, irradiating through his body as the sensation of something stuck deep inside him kept calling for his attention. “Ahhhh!” He screamed in pain while the cold sensation from the metal syringe quickly began to wane, allowing another sensation to be felt instead; a warm liquid seemed to emerge from within his belly button, tickling his skin as it gravitated down his legs. Looking down, Harry saw blood trickle out of his belly button, covering the massive syringe stuck there. He groaned as he tried to speak out loud, “Ahhh—Y—you sat—my face! Urgh!”
2e5399d24966.t: Kesakitan sejuk yang menusuk menceroboh perut Harry, memancar ke seluruh tubuhnya sementara sensasi sesuatu tersekat jauh di dalamnya terus memanggil perhatiannya. “Ahhhh!” Dia menjerit kesakitan sementara sensasi sejuk dari picagari logam itu cepat mula pudar, membiarkan sensasi lain dirasai sebaliknya; cecair hangat seakan-akan muncul dari dalam pusatnya, menggeletek kulitnya ketika ia mengalir ke bawah kakinya. Memandang ke bawah, Harry melihat darah menitis keluar dari pusatnya, menutupi picagari besar yang tersekat di situ. Dia mengerang sambil cuba bercakap dengan kuat, “Ahhh—A—awak duduk—muka saya! Urgh!”

3475c6123be0.en: “Don’t move!” Eori muffled Harry’s scream by holding her hand over his mouth, then tore off smaller slices of his face, from the cheeks to forehead, then a bundle of hair while she was at it. “Open your eyes!”
3475c6123be0.t: “Jangan bergerak!” Eori meredam jeritan Harry dengan menekup tangannya ke mulutnya, kemudian mengoyakkan kepingan-kepingan lebih kecil dari mukanya, dari pipi ke dahi, kemudian seikat rambut sementara dia di situ. “Buka mata kau!”

3491c264234f.en: With a heavy sigh, Eori let go of Harry’s neck and adjusted her long purple hair out of her face. Her furrowed brow and serious eyes gazed at him intensely as she tautly stated, “So?”
3491c264234f.t: Dengan keluhan berat, Eori melepaskan leher Harry dan membetulkan rambut ungu panjangnya dari mukanya. Dahinya yang berkerut dan matanya yang serius merenungnya dengan tajam sambil dia berkata dengan tegang, “Jadi?”

355b7579c085.en: Harry felt surges of pain and adrenaline run down his spine, his body uncontrollably trembling. A hot sweat began surfacing on his skin alongside the blood pouring from the multiple wounds. “AHHHHH!” A scream came out from Harry, feeling a deep pain strike his privates. Tears ran down his face as his hands shook the chains violently. He wanted to see what Eori was doing, but his head didn’t muster the courage to look down. He felt like his innards were plopping out through a gaping hole where his dick used to be—at least it felt like that.
355b7579c085.t: Harry merasakan lonjakan kesakitan dan adrenalina mengalir di tulang belakangnya, tubuhnya menggeletar tanpa kawalan. Peluh panas mula muncul di kulitnya bersama darah yang mencurah dari luka-luka yang banyak. “AHHHHH!” Satu jeritan keluar dari Harry, merasakan kesakitan yang dalam menyerang kemaluannya. Air mata mengalir di wajahnya sementara tangannya menggoncang rantai dengan ganas. Dia mahu melihat apa yang Eori lakukan, tetapi kepalanya tidak mampu mengumpul keberanian untuk menunduk. Dia merasakan seperti isi perutnya terjatuh keluar melalui lubang yang menganga di tempat koneknya dahulu—sekurang-kurangnya terasa begitu.

3699678f8acd.en: Eori backed off and watched over Harry as she held her bloodied scalpel. Her proud smile looked almost as if she knew what would happen.
3699678f8acd.t: Eori berundur dan memerhati Harry sambil memegang pisau bedahnya yang berdarah. Senyuman bangganya kelihatan hampir seolah-olah dia tahu apa yang akan berlaku.

36dc51c549c9.en: With the usual vicious grin, Eori, or rather long-haired Harry, came closer to Harry with a rather feminine hip swinging and rubbed her manly finger up and down on his chest. “Your eyes suck!” A vicious girly laugh came out in a masculine voice.
36dc51c549c9.t: Dengan sengihan ganas yang biasa, Eori, atau lebih tepat Harry berambut panjang, mendekati Harry dengan lenggang pinggul yang agak kewanitaan dan menggosok jari jantannya ke atas dan ke bawah dadanya. “Mata kau teruk!” Ketawa gadis yang ganas keluar dengan suara lelaki.

381835844941.en: “Look at me.” Eori held Harry’s chin with her hand. “And who am I?”
381835844941.t: “Pandang aku.” Eori memegang dagu Harry dengan tangannya. “Dan aku siapa?”

3981756a15b2.en: Eori shoved what appeared to be a third of the needle deep into Harry’s belly button. Her vicious smile grew even more assertive, reddening in the face as she bit her lips. “What did I do to you, then?”
3981756a15b2.t: Eori menyumbat kira-kira satu pertiga jarum itu jauh ke dalam pusat Harry. Senyuman ganasnya menjadi lebih tegas, wajahnya memerah sambil dia menggigit bibirnya. “Apa yang aku buat kat kau, kalau macam tu?”

3c6174c390ca.en: Memories poured in, all blurred with one another, with some blurrier than others, while some were somewhat vivid, with a few even feeling psychedelic. However, all these memories shared core similarities—he was always in the same spot, seeing an amalgamation of bodies converging to the same purple-haired girl experimenting on him. He kept seeing her injecting stuff into him, abusing him, and sometimes even slicing him open. He couldn’t figure out the order of it and what she was saying in the memories, but he could still feel the associated pain and what appeared to be either a vicious grin or an attentive seriousness. Not even a single tear came out of him; he felt too tired to even sob his heart out in this dark lonely basement. I just want to go home.
3c6174c390ca.t: Ingatan-ingatan mencurah masuk, semuanya kabur bercampur antara satu sama lain, dengan sesetengahnya lebih kabur daripada yang lain, manakala sesetengahnya agak jelas, dengan beberapa malah terasa psikedelik. Namun, semua ingatan ini berkongsi persamaan teras—dia sentiasa berada di tempat yang sama, melihat gabungan tubuh-tubuh yang bertumpu kepada gadis berambut ungu yang sama yang bereksperimen ke atasnya. Dia terus melihatnya menyuntik benda-benda ke dalamnya, mendera dirinya, dan kadang-kadang malah menghirisnya terbuka. Dia tidak dapat memahami urutannya dan apa yang dikatakan gadis itu dalam ingatan-ingatan itu, tetapi dia masih dapat merasakan kesakitan yang berkaitan dan sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti sengihan ganas atau keseriusan yang penuh perhatian. Tiada setitis pun air mata keluar daripadanya; dia terasa terlalu letih walaupun untuk teresak-esak meluahkan isi hatinya di bilik bawah tanah yang gelap dan sunyi ini. Aku cuma nak balik rumah.

3cc780d9d035.en: Harry’s eyes were mesmerized by the unrealness of it, yet it was real. He could not deny it as he touched the cold-ish bathtub water, feeling it was about ambient temperature.
3cc780d9d035.t: Mata Harry terpukau dengan ketidaknyataannya, namun ia nyata. Dia tidak dapat menafikannya ketika dia menyentuh air tab mandi yang agak sejuk, merasakan ia lebih kurang suhu sekeliling.

3e20a4e32a25.en: Crackling steps in the stairs gave Harry a familiar signal, bringing an anguished feeling with it. He felt his heart wanting to race again, but it was sluggish to do so, beating arrhythmic instead as he saw a familiar girly body dressed in pajamas walking downstairs, eating a sandwich. Wait—that’s Eori! Harry could now see clearly the face of the girl with purple hair experimenting on him, unlocking all other related memories and feelings too. The feelings themselves were so many and so intense that one would go crazy trying to process it all—maybe Harry somehow didn’t go crazy because he was too weak to feel anything thoroughly.
3e20a4e32a25.t: Bunyi langkah berderak di tangga memberi Harry isyarat yang biasa, membawa perasaan terseksa bersamanya. Dia merasakan jantungnya mahu berlumba lagi, tetapi ia lembap untuk berbuat demikian, sebaliknya berdegup tidak sekata ketika dia melihat tubuh gadis yang dikenali berpakaian piyama berjalan turun tangga, makan sandwic. Kejap—itu Eori! Harry kini dapat melihat dengan jelas wajah gadis berambut ungu yang bereksperimen ke atasnya, membuka kunci semua ingatan dan perasaan lain yang berkaitan juga. Perasaan-perasaan itu sendiri begitu banyak dan begitu kuat sehingga seseorang boleh jadi gila cuba memproses semuanya—mungkin Harry entah bagaimana tidak menjadi gila kerana dia terlalu lemah untuk merasakan apa-apa dengan sepenuhnya.

3e841b117602.en: “Harry—” Even the sound coming out of Harry’s mouth sounded half-dead as he felt a warmth tickling his esophagus and down into his belly.
3e841b117602.t: “Harry—” Malah bunyi yang keluar dari mulut Harry kedengaran separuh mati ketika dia merasakan kehangatan menggeletek esofagusnya dan turun ke perutnya.

44d379ede8ca.en: “Yes.” He remained looking at her with a visible frown and droopy eyes that seemed to be just about to break into tears. “I’m sorry—but I still remember everything. Please—please, Eori! Make me forget! Ple—”
44d379ede8ca.t: “Ya.” Dia terus memandangnya dengan kerutan yang ketara dan mata layu yang kelihatan hampir menangis. “Maaf—tapi saya masih ingat semuanya. Tolong—tolong, Eori! Buat saya lupa! To—”

475657ce1bbe.en: “Sorry, but how?” Harry felt her hand was on the cusp of slapping some sense into him instead.
475657ce1bbe.t: “Maaf, tapi macam mana?” Harry merasakan tangannya di ambang menampar supaya dia sedar sebaliknya.

487d3c6ff8ce.en: Eori grabbed Harry by the neck, holding it firmly in place, and banged his head against the wall. “STOP IT!” She glanced over the scalpel injury on Harry’s torso, finishing healing by itself, then she slid the scalpel on Harry’s stomach, making a deeper cut. “Let this be your fucking lesson.”
487d3c6ff8ce.t: Eori memegang leher Harry, memegangnya dengan kuat di tempatnya, dan menghantukkan kepalanya ke dinding. “BERHENTI!” Dia mengerling luka pisau bedah di badan Harry, yang selesai sembuh dengan sendirinya, kemudian dia menggelongsorkan pisau bedah itu ke perut Harry, membuat hirisan yang lebih dalam. “Biar ni jadi pengajaran celaka untuk kau.”

4c3720fddead.en: “I’m sorry—” Diverting his eyes from the purple-haired girl in pajamas, Harry clenched his mouth shut, afraid of anything else slipping out and making things worse.
4c3720fddead.t: “Maaf—” Mengalihkan matanya dari gadis berambut ungu berpiyama itu, Harry mengetap mulutnya rapat-rapat, takut apa-apa lagi terlepas dan memburukkan keadaan.

4c9d36d36d27.en: Finishing shaving the last spot of his beard, Eori walked over to the sink to clean the razor, sliding up the handle attached to a barrel by the sink to let out a trickle of water—just like the one from the basement. She pulled a sigil ring from the mirrored cabinet above the sink and chucked it towards Harry. “Fill the bathtub!”
4c9d36d36d27.t: Selesai mencukur bahagian terakhir janggutnya, Eori berjalan ke sinki untuk membersihkan pisau cukur itu, menggelongsor naik pemegang yang dipasang pada tong di tepi sinki untuk membiarkan setitis air keluar—sama seperti yang di bilik bawah tanah. Dia mengeluarkan cincin sigil dari kabinet bercermin di atas sinki dan mencampakkannya ke arah Harry. “Isi tab mandi!”

50703c696786.en: Eori squeezed the syringe dry with constant pressure, slowly letting the red liquid deep into Harry’s body before taking it out and placing it back on the table, farther away from the mixing bowls—possibly preventing cross-contamination.
50703c696786.t: Eori memerah picagari itu sehingga kering dengan tekanan berterusan, perlahan-lahan membiarkan cecair merah itu jauh ke dalam tubuh Harry sebelum mengeluarkannya dan meletakkannya semula di atas meja, lebih jauh dari mangkuk-mangkuk adunan—mungkin untuk mencegah pencemaran silang.

50c30888a3ce.en: With a deep breath amidst coughs, Harry felt live breath into his lungs again. “H—Harry.” The words came out of his mouth as soon as he could speak them.
50c30888a3ce.t: Dengan tarikan nafas dalam di tengah-tengah batuk, Harry merasakan nafas hidup memasuki paru-parunya sekali lagi. “H—Harry.” Kata-kata itu keluar dari mulutnya sebaik sahaja dia boleh menyebutnya.

5380089ad6ca.en: Syringe? Harry dropped his jaw at the sight of the behemoth thing in her hand. The needle girth alone was likely twice or three times the ones used for blood donations. A person prone to white coat hypertension would for sure have an anaphylactic shock if they saw a doctor holding that thing. Harry felt his veins scream in terror as his body clutched, preparing himself for the worst. His neck suddenly felt like it was pinched—like a phantom-pain type of pinching you feel right before you get a vaccine.
5380089ad6ca.t: Picagari? Rahang Harry terlopong melihat benda raksasa di tangannya. Ketebalan jarumnya sahaja mungkin dua atau tiga kali ganda jarum yang digunakan untuk menderma darah. Orang yang mudah mengalami hipertensi kot putih pasti akan mengalami kejutan anafilaktik jika melihat doktor memegang benda itu. Harry merasakan uratnya menjerit ketakutan ketika tubuhnya mengecut, bersedia untuk yang paling teruk. Lehernya tiba-tiba terasa seperti dicubit—seperti cubitan jenis sakit hantu yang kau rasa sebelum kau mendapat vaksin.

567d76183ee0.en: Like a sun piercing through the clouds, that nearly macabre-looking smile pierced through Harry’s foggier recent memories, bringing a bright, clear vision to his mind. “That night! It was you! But—but why?” Eori’s unique, overly pronounced ear-to-ear grin in front of him was the exact same as the one appearing on that amalgamation of bodies burned in his murky memories. Harry could now vividly see her girly naked figure on top of him as well. Her long purple hair, perky breasts, tantalizing nipples, and smooth-as-a-bald-man privates shone in the greenish moonlight as she sat on his face no longer felt like a hallucination.
567d76183ee0.t: Seperti matahari menembusi awan, senyuman yang hampir mengerikan itu menembusi ingatan baru Harry yang lebih berkabus, membawa penglihatan yang terang dan jelas ke fikirannya. “Malam tu! Awak orangnya! Tapi—tapi kenapa?” Sengihan unik Eori dari telinga ke telinga yang terlalu ketara di hadapannya sama betul dengan yang muncul pada gabungan tubuh-tubuh yang terbakar dalam ingatannya yang keruh. Harry kini dapat melihat dengan jelas susuk tubuh gadisnya yang bogel di atasnya juga. Rambut ungu panjangnya, buah dadanya yang tegang, putingnya yang menggoda, dan kemaluannya yang licin seperti kepala lelaki botak bersinar dalam cahaya bulan kehijauan ketika dia duduk di atas mukanya tidak lagi terasa seperti halusinasi.

56ecef54f679.en: Eori scratched a chair on the bare floor, bringing it towards Harry. She then stood on it.
56ecef54f679.t: Eori menggaru sebuah kerusi di atas lantai yang kosong, membawanya ke arah Harry. Dia kemudian berdiri di atasnya.

587924c5c9c2.en: “I—” Harry watched Eori undress, leaving her pajamaes on the floor below, revealing the rest of her, or technically speaking, his body manliness—or lack thereof as he for sure wasn’t the prime example of sexual appeal. Harry’s eyes were drawn to an identical version of his manly bits. The weirdness of the situation seemed just out of this world. “I—ahhh—not—sure?” He gulped, seeing how Eori’s face was exactly like his; apparently, even the shitty eyes as well—based on how much they squinted at each other.
587924c5c9c2.t: “Saya—” Harry melihat Eori menanggalkan pakaian, meninggalkan piyamanya di lantai di bawah, mendedahkan baki dirinya, atau secara teknikalnya, kejantanan tubuh lelaki itu—atau ketiadaannya kerana dia pastinya bukan contoh utama daya tarikan seksual. Mata Harry tertarik kepada versi serupa anggota jantannya. Keanehan situasi itu kelihatan luar biasa. “Saya—ahhh—tak—pasti?” Dia menelan liur, melihat betapa wajah Eori betul-betul seperti wajahnya; nampaknya, malah mata yang teruk juga—berdasarkan betapa mereka saling mengecilkan mata.

58a846f4739f.en: Wait—is this me? His voice slowly developed in his head as the pain of his guts and blood pouring out of his belly kicked in, but no scream came out of his mouth. Even moving his eyes didn’t seem actually to do anything. His ears were now picking up a bunch of jumbled noises that sounded deeper and deeper coming from Eori as if everything was progressively grinding to a halt.
58a846f4739f.t: Kejap—ini aku ke? Suaranya perlahan-lahan terbentuk dalam kepalanya ketika kesakitan isi perut dan darah yang mencurah keluar dari perutnya mula terasa, tetapi tiada jeritan yang keluar dari mulutnya. Malah menggerakkan matanya tidak kelihatan benar-benar melakukan apa-apa. Telinganya kini menangkap sekumpulan bunyi bercampur aduk yang kedengaran semakin dalam dan dalam datang dari Eori seolah-olah segala-galanya beransur-ansur terhenti.

5d1c036e3fbd.en: Eori seemingly stopped shaving Harry’s beard. Her eyes surveyed his body with a specific scientific glint in them. “Were you always this hairy?”
5d1c036e3fbd.t: Eori seakan-akan berhenti mencukur janggut Harry. Matanya meninjau tubuhnya dengan sinar saintifik tertentu di dalamnya. “Kau memang berbulu macam ni dari dulu ke?”

5e7efb0bb049.en: Eori pulled his head back and continued scrapping a very sharp razor on his skin, giving him a clean, precise shave despite squinting her eyes.
5e7efb0bb049.t: Eori menarik kepalanya ke belakang dan terus menggesek pisau cukur yang sangat tajam pada kulitnya, memberikannya cukuran yang bersih dan tepat walaupun mengecilkan matanya.

5f8cf559dfe3.en: “Dammit! Now he had to go and shit himself too!” Eori’s grating voice slowly echoed through Harry’s brain. “Mixing Time Slower was fucking stupid.”
5f8cf559dfe3.t: “Sial! Sekarang dia pergi berak dalam seluar pula!” Suara Eori yang kasar perlahan-lahan bergema melalui otak Harry. “Campurkan Time Slower memang bodoh celaka.”

60493f454d23.en: He then saw Eiri’s face in his memories, specifically when Eiri explained what the role of Sanbi-eye would be. Plus, you could think of it as having a stable job for the next thirty-nine years, just traveling around the countryside in a peaceful job which does have its own charms. Eiri’s voice echoed in Harry’s mind as the realness of his current situation was getting way too fucking real. Was Eiri lying all along? She did not help me during dinner when Neferteri gave the contract, so maybe it was all a lie? Then is the story about me being from the slums even true? Harry let out a long, pained breath—I don’t know anymore. Maybe everything is a lie, including the stuff about Itagiba asking whoever it was to create a fake skin that matched what Maiara wanted. Harry moved his tired eyeballs towards the stairs leading up somewhere unknown. If only I could escape—but where would I go? I don’t know where I am; I don’t know anyone; and I guess I can’t trust anyone either, even Hiromi—
60493f454d23.t: Dia kemudian melihat wajah Eiri dalam ingatannya, khususnya ketika Eiri menerangkan apa peranan Sanbi-eye. Tambahan pula, kau boleh anggap ia macam ada kerja tetap untuk tiga puluh sembilan tahun akan datang, cuma mengembara sekitar desa dalam kerja yang aman yang ada daya tarikannya tersendiri. Suara Eiri bergema dalam fikiran Harry ketika realiti keadaannya sekarang menjadi terlalu nyata, celaka. Eiri tipu dari awal ke? Dia tak tolong aku masa makan malam bila Neferteri bagi kontrak tu, jadi mungkin semuanya tipu? Kalau macam tu cerita pasal aku dari setinggan tu betul ke? Harry menghembus nafas panjang yang sakit—Aku dah tak tahu. Mungkin semuanya tipu, termasuk cerita pasal Itagiba minta siapa pun orang tu cipta fake skin yang sepadan dengan apa yang Maiara nak. Harry menggerakkan biji matanya yang letih ke arah tangga yang menuju ke atas ke suatu tempat yang tidak diketahui. Kalaulah aku boleh lari—tapi ke mana aku nak pergi? Aku tak tahu aku kat mana; aku tak kenal sesiapa; dan rasanya aku tak boleh percaya sesiapa juga, Hiromi pun—

61058e494d83.en: “As expected,” Eori said, but her, or perhaps his, voice sounded like Harry’s. “So what does looking at yourself feel like?”
61058e494d83.t: “Seperti yang dijangka,” Eori berkata, tetapi suaranya, atau mungkin suara lelaki itu, kedengaran seperti suara Harry. “Jadi apa rasanya tengok diri sendiri?”

61388627c821.en: “My throat—I—someone—killed me—” Harry spoke those words as he felt the agonizing terror and ensuing peaceful bliss at the same time—the dichotomy of those two feelings seemed to be washing away each other, leaving Harry with just the anxiety sense that he had to do something, but no idea what it was.
61388627c821.t: “Kerongkong saya—saya—seseorang—bunuh saya—” Harry menyebut kata-kata itu sambil merasakan ketakutan yang menyeksakan dan kebahagiaan tenang yang menyusul pada masa yang sama—dikotomi dua perasaan itu seakan-akan menghanyutkan satu sama lain, meninggalkan Harry hanya dengan rasa resah bahawa dia perlu melakukan sesuatu, tetapi tidak tahu apa.

61f82568edfc.en: The cold, damp floor felt like he was in a five-star hotel bed. He could have taken a nap right then and there, but he saw Eori approach with shackles in hand. In his mind, he saw an opportunity to stand up and take off running, but his feeble body didn’t respond. Instead, his body went ahead and moved his hands towards her before his brain had the time to think of anything else.
61f82568edfc.t: Lantai yang sejuk dan lembap terasa seperti dia berada di katil hotel lima bintang. Dia boleh tidur sekejap di situ juga, tetapi dia melihat Eori mendekat dengan belenggu di tangan. Dalam fikirannya, dia melihat peluang untuk berdiri dan berlari, tetapi tubuhnya yang lemah tidak bertindak balas. Sebaliknya, tubuhnya terus menggerakkan tangannya ke arahnya sebelum otaknya sempat memikirkan apa-apa lagi.

63b577bf4e7b.en: Doing so, Harry managed to follow what Eori said, but nothing happened. The five rings and the fire going up the arm were not there at all—he basically looked just like any other weeb making ADHD-fueled obnoxious hand gestures.
63b577bf4e7b.t: Menurut, Harry berjaya mengikut apa yang Eori katakan, tetapi tiada apa-apa berlaku. Lima gelang dan api yang naik ke lengan langsung tiada—dia pada dasarnya kelihatan seperti mana-mana weeb lain yang membuat gerakan tangan menjengkelkan yang dibakar ADHD.

642e7dc874e3.en: Looking face-to-face at this beautiful pink-eyed girl with long, voluptuous purple hair dressed in comfortable, cute pajamas, Harry knew who she was, so he spoke up, and this time his voice not sounding as dead, “Eori.” He averted his gaze from her pretty pinkish irises as an energetic feeling radiated from his stomach into his body.
642e7dc874e3.t: Bertentang muka dengan gadis cantik bermata merah jambu ini dengan rambut ungu panjang yang lebat berpakaian piyama yang selesa dan comel, Harry tahu siapa dia, jadi dia bersuara, dan kali ini suaranya tidak kedengaran semati tadi, “Eori.” Dia mengalihkan pandangannya dari iris merah jambunya yang cantik ketika perasaan bertenaga memancar dari perutnya ke seluruh tubuhnya.

6521c8680f3e.en: The pain all over Harry’s body began to equalize into a kind of generalized numb unwellness. His ear heard Eori’s request, but his eyes clenched further, disobeying her demand and his pleading brain. His body suddenly shook violently in despair as the would-be pain he felt in his eyes became real when the blade forced itself into his eye socket, violating it forcefully.
6521c8680f3e.t: Kesakitan di seluruh tubuh Harry mula menyamarata menjadi sejenis rasa tidak sihat yang kebas secara menyeluruh. Telinganya mendengar permintaan Eori, tetapi matanya terpejam lebih rapat, mengingkari tuntutannya dan otaknya yang merayu. Tubuhnya tiba-tiba menggigil dengan ganas dalam keputusasaan apabila kesakitan yang bakal dirasainya di matanya menjadi nyata apabila bilah itu memaksa masuk ke soket matanya, mencabulnya dengan kasar.

67b2e7743b06.en: “It was you! YOU KILLED ME!” Harry’s mind unlocked what Eori said right before she killed him. He tried to break away again, but the chains around his wrists hanging him high from the ground made it impossible. “WHY?”
67b2e7743b06.t: “Awak! AWAK YANG BUNUH SAYA!” Fikiran Harry membuka kunci apa yang dikatakan Eori sebelum dia membunuhnya. Dia cuba melepaskan diri lagi, tetapi rantai di pergelangan tangannya yang menggantungnya tinggi dari tanah menjadikannya mustahil. “KENAPA?”

6971e1f286d1.en: The five white soul flame rings in her forearm, with the smallest one near her wrists, and the four balls of red double helices strand zipping around Eori’s forearm clashed ahead, fusing into her palm, then into Harry.
6971e1f286d1.t: Lima gelang api jiwa putih di lengan bawahnya, dengan yang paling kecil berhampiran pergelangan tangannya, dan empat bola merah helaian heliks berganda yang meluncur di sekeliling lengan bawah Eori berlaga ke depan, bercantum ke dalam tapak tangannya, kemudian ke dalam Harry.

69bd460444b4.en: Harry tried to imagine this safe haven, but his corrupted memories seemed dissonant—something about a grayish large-looking city with metal-looking boxy things that had to be cars everywhere. His phantasia then added lights in the middle of the streets that flashed from red to green, then yellow, then back to red. The symphony of light brought the sound of a reeving engine and horn hooking that felt like they were coming right from outside the window. Is Tolerideme that different from Sanbi Kingdom? I remember it being red and something about the three smart ladies in that book, but not that. Wait! Would they even take me in? Would I need the badge too? Something in his mind, unfortunately, clicked. Is that why Sinoi took my badge?
69bd460444b4.t: Harry cuba membayangkan tempat perlindungan selamat ini, tetapi ingatannya yang rosak kelihatan sumbang—sesuatu tentang kota besar yang kelabu dengan benda-benda berbentuk kotak yang kelihatan seperti logam yang pasti kereta di merata tempat. Fantasianya kemudian menambah lampu di tengah-tengah jalan yang berkelip dari merah ke hijau, kemudian kuning, kemudian kembali ke merah. Simfoni cahaya membawa bunyi enjin menderum dan hon membunyi yang terasa seperti datang betul-betul dari luar tingkap. Tolerideme berbeza sangat ke dari Kerajaan Sanbi? Aku ingat ia merah dan sesuatu pasal tiga wanita bijak dalam buku tu, tapi bukan macam tu. Kejap! Mereka akan terima aku ke? Aku perlukan lencana juga ke? Sesuatu dalam fikirannya, malangnya, terlintas. Sebab tu ke Sinoi ambil lencana aku?

6c13243f255e.en: “My chest—” Harry shut himself up, now feeling a tight grip on his throat. He really wanted to move his hand to scratch his chest; his brain told his hand so, but it didn’t move or even flinch.
6c13243f255e.t: “Dada saya—” Harry mendiamkan dirinya, kini merasakan cengkaman kuat di kerongkongnya. Dia betul-betul mahu menggerakkan tangannya untuk menggaru dadanya; otaknya menyuruh tangannya berbuat begitu, tetapi ia tidak bergerak atau tersentak pun.

6de1b0728300.en: “What about before you woke up? Do you remember anything new you haven’t told Eiri before?” Eori continued to play with her purple hair. “Any names? places?”
6de1b0728300.t: “Macam mana sebelum kau tersedar? Kau ingat apa-apa yang baru yang kau belum bagi tahu Eiri sebelum ni?” Eori terus bermain dengan rambut ungunya. “Apa-apa nama? tempat?”

7048bd563752.en: Vol 2 Chapter III subchapter 4: Harry hangs alone by his wrists from chains in a dark stone room lit by a lantern.
7048bd563752.t: Jilid 2 Bab III subbab 4: Harry tergantung seorang diri pada pergelangan tangannya dari rantai di bilik batu gelap yang diterangi tanglung.

71e6e3e5879d.en: Harry could remember vividly getting into the carriage and things here and there, like when he saw the kids playing some sort of duel at some point. “I—thought I was going to pass by The Dead Wozen?” Harry’s memories were murkier after that point. “Wait—I did pass by it!” A single fuzzy moment came to mind, and it was seeing all the villagers happily dancing away. “Something bad happened after I saw the villagers all happy and dancing.” His eyes grew moist, while everything else afterward seemed blanked in a fog of war of agony, terror with loneliness sprinkled for added taste. “Please, just let me go! I didn—”
71e6e3e5879d.t: Harry dapat mengingati dengan jelas menaiki kereta dan perkara-perkara di sana sini, seperti ketika dia melihat kanak-kanak bermain sejenis pertarungan pada satu ketika. “Saya—ingat saya akan lalu The Dead Wozen?” Ingatan Harry lebih keruh selepas titik itu. “Kejap—saya memang lalu situ!” Satu saat yang kabur terlintas di fikiran, dan ia melihat semua penduduk kampung menari dengan gembira. “Sesuatu yang buruk berlaku lepas saya nampak penduduk kampung semua gembira dan menari.” Matanya berkaca, sementara segala yang lain selepas itu seakan-akan kosong dalam kabus perang keperitan, ketakutan dengan kesunyian ditabur untuk menambah rasa. “Tolong, lepaskan saya je! Saya tak—”

744674f01393.en: Eori pointed the armed crossbow at Harry, making an odd short double high-pitched call with her mouth before firing it off, making a sharp metallic bang on wood echo in the room.
744674f01393.t: Eori menghalakan busur silang yang telah dipasang ke arah Harry, membuat panggilan berganda pendek bernada tinggi yang ganjil dengan mulutnya sebelum melepaskannya, membuatkan dentuman logam tajam pada kayu bergema di bilik itu.

76853a3b9f5e.en: With a displeased smile but still with the same serious gaze, Eori backed away, grabbing an open pinkish journal from the table and perusing through her notes. “Do you remember how you got here?”
76853a3b9f5e.t: Dengan senyuman tidak puas hati tetapi masih dengan renungan serius yang sama, Eori berundur, mengambil sebuah jurnal merah jambu yang terbuka dari meja dan meneliti notanya. “Kau ingat macam mana kau sampai ke sini?”

7c617a85cadc.en: “There’s more!” Eori shoved another spoonful down Harry’s throat with one hand, but this time not as forcefully rapey.
7c617a85cadc.t: “Ada lagi!” Eori menyumbat sesudu lagi ke kerongkong Harry dengan sebelah tangan, tetapi kali ini tidak sekasar merogol.

7d152de5cc60.en: In Harry’s memories, it felt like it was yesterday that Eiri was being playful with him, trying to make him swallow that grotesque concoction to fix his eyeballs. His sobbing slowed down to a sniff; his tearful tone could only reply, “I—I guess no?”
7d152de5cc60.t: Dalam ingatan Harry, ia terasa seperti baru semalam Eiri bergurau dengannya, cuba membuatnya menelan campuran yang menjijikkan itu untuk membetulkan biji matanya. Esakannya perlahan menjadi hingusan; nadanya yang berair mata hanya mampu menjawab, “Sa—saya rasa tak?”

7fbb3bf87d44.en: Eori attempted to carve out his right eyeball; the blade was going deep in his eyesocket, ready to scoop out his eye. “Dammit! I popped it!” Eori shoved Harry’s head forward, shoving her fingers inside his eye socket. “I told you to open it! But no! You had to fucking disobey!” Her tone grew snappier.
7fbb3bf87d44.t: Eori cuba mengukir keluar biji mata kanannya; bilah itu masuk jauh ke dalam soket matanya, bersedia untuk menyudu keluar matanya. “Sial! Aku dah pecahkan!” Eori menolak kepala Harry ke depan, menyumbat jarinya ke dalam soket matanya. “Aku dah suruh kau buka! Tapi tak! Kau kena ingkar juga, celaka!” Nadanya menjadi lebih garang.

806cefa60b41.en: Eori dropped the scoop-sized hunk of meat into the mixing bowl below with a wet plop sound. With a massive grin from eye to eye, she began taking scoops of meat from the other arm, from the belly, and legs—her eyes seemed to concentrate on making equal-sized cuts. “You’re making it go quick and easy this time—good!” She then flayed a perfect slice of Harry’s chest as if she had skinned plenty of animals before in her lifetime.
806cefa60b41.t: Eori menjatuhkan seketul daging sebesar sesudu itu ke dalam mangkuk adunan di bawah dengan bunyi lecak basah. Dengan sengihan besar dari mata ke mata, dia mula menyudu daging dari lengan yang lagi satu, dari perut, dan kaki—matanya kelihatan menumpukan perhatian untuk membuat potongan yang sama saiz. “Kau buat ia cepat dan senang kali ni—bagus!” Dia kemudian melapah sekeping sempurna dada Harry seolah-olah dia telah melapah banyak haiwan sebelum ini sepanjang hidupnya.

829aafce2c8c.en: Eori didn’t flinch. She focused on finishing slicing the chunks of Harry’s meat and adding them all into the mixing bowl. She washed her hands, grabbed a scoop of ground nari stone, a bluish grounded crystal, and added it to the mixing bowl. “Don’t you know how I made the Fake Eye that Eiri gave you?” Grabbing a large wooden spoon, she began to mix it up with vigor, adding a bit of vinegar to the mix.
829aafce2c8c.t: Eori tidak tersentak. Dia menumpukan perhatian untuk menghabiskan menghiris ketulan daging Harry dan memasukkan semuanya ke dalam mangkuk adunan. Dia mencuci tangannya, mengambil sesudu batu nari yang dikisar, kristal kebiruan yang dikisar, dan menambahnya ke dalam mangkuk adunan. “Kau tak tahu macam mana aku buat Fake Eye yang Eiri bagi kau?” Mengambil sudu kayu besar, dia mula mengacaunya dengan bersemangat, menambah sedikit cuka ke dalam campuran itu.

83a8292e4e62.en: Eori, meanwhile, was busy writing away at her desk. Her hands moved precisely, not lifting the winga feather from the page as the continuous line zigzagged, forming letters, each having its own invisible boxy boundaries. These boxes were then connected to create words like cursive handwriting, with all letters, including space, combining into one another at half-height instead. Reaching the right end of the page, she would dip the feather in more ink by pure muscle memory and continue writing in the line below at the same speed. By her, four macabre-looking jars contained quite the selection: one brownish with chunks of something stalky; two reddish ones appeared closer to arterial blood in color, with one having a fleshy, stringy thing while the other looked like whiskers; and the fourth one was filled with a darker blood-red fluid, rather close to venous blood. A clean mixing bowl and a single empty nari gel glass were also by her side, all waiting for Eori to concoct another experiment.
83a8292e4e62.t: Eori, sementara itu, sibuk menulis di mejanya. Tangannya bergerak dengan tepat, tidak mengangkat bulu winga dari halaman ketika garis berterusan itu berzig-zag, membentuk huruf-huruf, setiap satu dengan sempadan kotak ghaibnya sendiri. Kotak-kotak ini kemudian disambungkan untuk mencipta perkataan seperti tulisan sambung, dengan semua huruf, termasuk ruang, bercantum antara satu sama lain pada separuh ketinggian sebaliknya. Sampai di hujung kanan halaman, dia akan mencelup bulu itu ke dalam lebih banyak dakwat dengan ingatan otot semata-mata dan terus menulis di baris di bawah dengan kelajuan yang sama. Di sebelahnya, empat balang yang kelihatan mengerikan mengandungi pilihan yang agak menarik: satu keperangan dengan ketulan sesuatu yang bertangkai; dua yang kemerahan kelihatan lebih hampir dengan darah arteri warnanya, dengan satu mengandungi benda berdaging dan berserat sementara yang lagi satu kelihatan seperti misai; dan yang keempat dipenuhi cecair merah darah yang lebih gelap, agak hampir dengan darah vena. Sebuah mangkuk adunan yang bersih dan sebiji kaca nari gel kosong juga berada di sisinya, semuanya menunggu Eori meramu eksperimen lain.

8452ea659cf5.en: Eori went back to the mirrored cabinet and chucked another sigil towards Harry. “Figure it out yourself if you want to heat it—if you dare to try anything else, I will fucking scalp your entire skin.”
8452ea659cf5.t: Eori kembali ke kabinet bercermin dan mencampakkan satu lagi sigil ke arah Harry. “Fikir sendiri kalau kau nak panaskan—kalau kau berani cuba apa-apa lagi, aku akan kupas seluruh kulit kau, celaka.”

872d6f7e2dec.en: Eori placed chains on both Harry’s hands and feet. With her manly bits still flapping, she walked back to another one of the closets beneath the stairs and took out a mop. “Clean this shit up!”
872d6f7e2dec.t: Eori memasang rantai pada kedua-dua tangan dan kaki Harry. Dengan anggota jantannya masih berayun, dia berjalan kembali ke salah satu almari lain di bawah tangga dan mengeluarkan mop. “Bersihkan benda celaka ni!”

899e5f021a28.en: Continuing mixing while carefully checking the texture of the macabre slurp, Eori replied without looking at him, “It was someone’s eyeballs. They sold it to a harvester, the soul energy department bought it, and I used to make a Fake Eye for you.” She added a bit more grounded-up nari stone, bringing the concoction to a jelly-like texture.
899e5f021a28.t: Terus mengacau sambil memeriksa dengan teliti tekstur bubur yang mengerikan itu, Eori menjawab tanpa memandangnya, “Itu biji mata seseorang. Mereka jual pada penuai, jabatan tenaga jiwa beli, dan aku guna untuk buat Fake Eye untuk kau.” Dia menambah sedikit lagi batu nari yang dikisar, membawa campuran itu kepada tekstur seperti jeli.

90fa6adbc19a.en: Harry looked at his kinda hairy arms. “Not—sure? I was fatter—that I remember.” With a frank tone, Harry glanced at Eori, but all he saw was a near mirror image of himself looking down on him, except she was clearly hairless compared to him.
90fa6adbc19a.t: Harry memandang lengannya yang agak berbulu. “Tak—pasti? Saya lagi gemuk—itu saya ingat.” Dengan nada terus terang, Harry mengerling Eori, tetapi yang dia nampak hanyalah imej cermin hampir serupa dirinya memandang ke bawah kepadanya, kecuali dia jelas tidak berbulu berbanding dirinya.

91de18237611.en: “Stop freaking out. You’re just making the Body Heal take longer.” Eori said, grabbing the bowl with meat scoops and blood from beneath Harry. She placed it on the table, grabbed a cutting board with an ultra-sharp knife, and carefully sliced the blood-soaked meat into thin strips—like she was trying to make fajitas.
91de18237611.t: “Berhentilah menggelabah. Kau cuma buat Body Heal ambil masa lebih lama.” Eori berkata, mengambil mangkuk berisi sudu-sudu daging dan darah dari bawah Harry. Dia meletakkannya di atas meja, mengambil papan pemotong dengan pisau yang sangat tajam, dan dengan berhati-hati menghiris daging yang basah dengan darah itu menjadi jalur-jalur nipis—seperti dia cuba membuat fajita.

9573cc7edbf5.en: “That’s fine,” Eori said in a severe manly tone, pulling the sigil ring from his hand, wearing it on her right hand, and starting the spell flawlessly in her left hand, making a trail of ghastly harmless white fire emerge from her middle and ring fingers, and rush up her arm, in a vein-like pattern, towards her back. Afterward, five circles of white fire popped into existence around her left arm—surging from the white fire in her forearm. Eori turned her left palm towards Harry. “Now try to feed.”
9573cc7edbf5.t: “Tak apa,” Eori berkata dengan nada jantan yang tegas, menarik cincin sigil dari tangannya, memakainya di tangan kanannya, dan memulakan jampi dengan sempurna di tangan kirinya, membuatkan jejak api putih pucat yang tidak berbahaya muncul dari jari tengah dan jari manisnya, dan menerpa naik lengannya, dalam corak seperti urat, ke arah belakangnya. Selepas itu, lima bulatan api putih muncul di sekeliling lengan kirinya—terpancar dari api putih di lengan bawahnya. Eori memalingkan tapak tangan kirinya ke arah Harry. “Sekarang cuba suap.”

9612fee70308.en: Harry’s ears ringed as his mind was still trying to flee whatever this whole thing was. However, his body began losing its will to fight as his lungs ran out of oxygen. The urge to breathe was now only growing stronger, feeling something looming on the horizon.
9612fee70308.t: Telinga Harry berdesing sementara fikirannya masih cuba melarikan diri dari apa pun semua ini. Namun, tubuhnya mula hilang kemahuan untuk melawan ketika paru-parunya kehabisan oksigen. Desakan untuk bernafas kini hanya semakin kuat, merasakan sesuatu yang menghampiri di ufuk.

9698e1aae8a9.en: Opening his eyes slowly, Harry regained the sense of who he was; his name came back to him as if it had been on the tip of his tongue for a while. The basement’s cold, slightly stale air smelled like piss, and the only light source in the room was slowly dying—just like him on the inside. Harry’s back felt the moist cold wall, while his shoulders and arms felt nothing but a constant numbness. Using what was left of his willpower, he moved his heavy head up to look around the room. The blurriness of his vision after an arm’s length was still there, and even though it was kinda dark, he could tell exactly where he was but not how he got there. Wait—how long have I even been here?
9698e1aae8a9.t: Membuka matanya perlahan-lahan, Harry kembali sedar siapa dirinya; namanya kembali kepadanya seolah-olah ia telah berada di hujung lidahnya sekian lama. Udara bilik bawah tanah yang sejuk dan sedikit hapak berbau kencing, dan satu-satunya sumber cahaya dalam bilik itu perlahan-lahan padam—sama seperti dirinya di dalam. Belakang Harry merasakan dinding sejuk yang lembap, manakala bahu dan lengannya tidak merasakan apa-apa selain kebas yang berterusan. Menggunakan sisa kemahuannya, dia menggerakkan kepalanya yang berat ke atas untuk memandang sekeliling bilik. Kekaburan penglihatannya selepas jarak sedepa masih ada, dan walaupun agak gelap, dia dapat tahu dengan tepat di mana dia berada tetapi bukan bagaimana dia sampai ke situ. Kejap—dah berapa lama aku kat sini?

99a1a92e2efb.en: Placing the mug on the table, Eori seemed keen to observe Harry’s frail body, paying close attention to his face. “Who are you?”
99a1a92e2efb.t: Meletakkan kole itu di atas meja, Eori kelihatan berminat memerhati tubuh Harry yang lemah, memberi perhatian rapi kepada wajahnya. “Kau siapa?”

9c0356106973.en: “Don’t move!” Eori got down from the chair and picked up a new set of chains from the closet below the stairs.
9c0356106973.t: “Jangan bergerak!” Eori turun dari kerusi dan mengambil set rantai baharu dari almari di bawah tangga.

9c401694a029.en: Harry suddenly awakened to a tight grip around his neck. He inhaled air with a guttural sound, trying to fill his lungs. It felt like his life was being taken away, but he could still breathe. The whole thing felt like a nightmare at first, but the surreal pain made it real. Why? His bulging, frantic eyes stared at the familiar girl before him—Eori, the princess he had seen when he first awakened at Sanbi Castle. A wheezy voice came out of him. “E—o—agh” He choked on his saliva. The pleasure on her face and her smile seemed almost charming, except for the fact that it was her hands squishing the life out of him.
9c401694a029.t: Harry tiba-tiba tersedar dengan cengkaman kuat di lehernya. Dia menyedut udara dengan bunyi dari kerongkong, cuba memenuhi paru-parunya. Ia terasa seperti nyawanya sedang dirampas, tetapi dia masih boleh bernafas. Semua itu terasa seperti mimpi ngeri pada mulanya, tetapi kesakitan yang tidak nyata itu menjadikannya nyata. Kenapa? Matanya yang terbeliak dan panik merenung gadis yang dikenali di hadapannya—Eori, puteri yang dilihatnya ketika dia mula-mula tersedar di Istana Sanbi. Suara berdesit keluar daripadanya. “E—o—agh” Dia tercekik air liurnya. Kenikmatan di wajahnya dan senyumannya kelihatan hampir menawan, kecuali hakikat bahawa tangannyalah yang sedang memerah nyawa keluar daripadanya.

9eb4ef77cc1e.en: Harry glanced again through the familiar basement and its eerie scientific vibes. Even though anything farther away than an arm’s length was still blurrier than the pixelated privates of a JAV, he could still infer enough details to know there was no way out—except the stairs. His arms usually screamed in pain at him, but lately, it seemed they were growing accustomed to their new position above his head—or perhaps it was a lingering effect of whatever concoctions Eori injected. Harry had no idea anymore, and neither did his dangling feet. They tried everything, from trying to use the table in front of them as support to get his hands free to simply just kicking Eori in her cunt as hard as possible. However, all he ever gained from disobeying was getting slapped, punched, kicked back, strangled, and sometimes the temporary sweet relief of death when Eori would slice him up. He glanced silently towards Eori, his mind ran out of any further defense attempts, or possible plans—or simply gave up. Hard to tell at this point.
9eb4ef77cc1e.t: Harry mengerling lagi bilik bawah tanah yang biasa itu dan aura saintifiknya yang menyeramkan. Walaupun apa sahaja yang lebih jauh dari sedepa masih lebih kabur daripada kemaluan yang dipiksel dalam JAV, dia masih dapat membuat kesimpulan butiran yang cukup untuk tahu tiada jalan keluar—kecuali tangga. Lengannya biasanya menjerit kesakitan kepadanya, tetapi kebelakangan ini, ia seakan-akan semakin biasa dengan kedudukan baharunya di atas kepalanya—atau mungkin itu kesan berpanjangan apa pun campuran yang disuntik Eori. Harry tidak tahu lagi, dan begitu juga kakinya yang terjuntai. Ia telah mencuba segala-galanya, dari cuba menggunakan meja di hadapannya sebagai sokongan untuk membebaskan tangannya hingga sekadar menendang puki Eori sekuat mungkin. Namun, yang dia dapat dari keingkaran hanyalah ditampar, ditumbuk, ditendang balik, dicekik, dan kadang-kadang kelegaan manis kematian yang sementara apabila Eori menghirisnya. Dia mengerling dalam diam ke arah Eori, fikirannya kehabisan sebarang percubaan pertahanan lagi, atau rancangan yang mungkin—atau sekadar berputus asa. Sukar untuk dipastikan pada tahap ini.
