a321069086bc.en: Her sense of pleasure still coursed through her face as she grabbed a scalpel and approached Harry. She held him by the throat with one hand while the other ran the scalpel down his chest, making a thin superficial cut. “Do you feel this?” Eori asked, looking at the blood pooling on his chest wound, releasing the grip on his neck.
a321069086bc.t: Rasa kenikmatannya masih mengalir di wajahnya ketika dia mengambil pisau bedah dan mendekati Harry. Dia memegang kerongkongnya dengan sebelah tangan sementara tangan yang lagi satu menggerakkan pisau bedah itu ke bawah dadanya, membuat hirisan nipis di permukaan. “Kau rasa ni?” Eori bertanya, memandang darah yang berlopak di luka dadanya, melepaskan cengkaman di lehernya.

aafa4892247d.en: “Like this.” Eori clenched her right hand but left her middle and ring fingers out flat—as if she were flipping the bird. A bluish fire emerged and waved back and forth excitedly to become whatever its master demanded. She then fed the spell into the other hand, making roughly a ball of marble-sized water appear on the smallest ring and spin around like it was trying to escape. “Now, do it too.”
aafa4892247d.t: “Macam ni.” Eori mengepal tangan kanannya tetapi membiarkan jari tengah dan jari manisnya lurus—seolah-olah dia menunjukkan isyarat lucah. Api kebiruan muncul dan beralun ke depan dan ke belakang dengan teruja untuk menjadi apa sahaja yang dituntut tuannya. Dia kemudian menyuapkan jampi itu ke tangan yang lagi satu, membuatkan sebiji bola air kira-kira sebesar guli muncul pada gelang paling kecil dan berputar seolah-olah ia cuba melarikan diri. “Sekarang, kau buat juga.”

ab920d09458d.en: Eori stroked Harry’s eyebrow, then hers, perhaps measuring density. She then looked at her hairless chest, arms, and legs. Raising Harry’s arms without asking, she carefully analyzed his armpit hair against hers. “Something is off. I will investigate more after dinner.” Eori kept on shaving Harry. “Your neck beard is shit, just like the fat pricks from Tolerideme.”
ab920d09458d.t: Eori mengusap kening Harry, kemudian keningnya sendiri, mungkin mengukur ketebalannya. Dia kemudian memandang dada, lengan dan kakinya yang tidak berbulu. Mengangkat lengan Harry tanpa bertanya, dia menganalisis dengan teliti bulu ketiaknya berbanding miliknya. “Ada sesuatu yang tak kena. Aku akan siasat lagi lepas makan malam.” Eori terus mencukur Harry. “Janggut leher kau teruk, sama macam mamat gemuk celaka dari Tolerideme.”

addaa2117e68.en: Looking around this unfamiliar room, Harry’s eyes couldn’t see any details due to the blurriness of his vision, but he could mentally assume a few things. There was a writing desk to his left, a grinder in the corner, and a plethora of metallic pointy things shining on top of another table between the grinder and jars of macabre stuff stacked in the wall of the other corner. The grinder had the same bluish hues as the one he had seen on the ground floor of the Sanbi castle’s southwest tower. Same for the wall of macabre stuff, but this time it was even more festive in colors, with the jars in the bottom rows being on the redder spectrum, holding who-knows-what inside, while the jars in the upper rows banded in different hues from cyan, magenta, yellow, to black and artful mixes of them. Looking at the table in front of him, he saw a well-illuminated fost lamp as the only light source in the room, and by it, four mixing bowls all looking reddish with some stuff inside he couldn’t quite see. Inside each mixing bowl was something metallic and girthy. Three of these metallic girthy things were filled with the same reddish concoction.
addaa2117e68.t: Memandang sekeliling bilik yang tidak dikenali ini, mata Harry tidak dapat melihat sebarang butiran kerana penglihatannya yang kabur, tetapi dia dapat mengandaikan beberapa perkara dalam fikiran. Ada meja tulis di sebelah kirinya, pengisar di sudut, dan lambakan benda logam tajam berkilauan di atas meja lain di antara pengisar dan balang-balang benda mengerikan yang disusun di dinding sudut yang lain. Pengisar itu mempunyai warna kebiruan yang sama seperti yang dilihatnya di tingkat bawah menara barat daya istana Sanbi. Sama juga dengan dinding benda-benda mengerikan itu, tetapi kali ini lebih meriah warnanya, dengan balang-balang di baris bawah dalam spektrum lebih merah, mengandungi entah apa di dalamnya, manakala balang-balang di baris atas berjalur dalam warna berbeza dari biru kehijauan, magenta, kuning, hingga hitam dan campuran seninya. Memandang meja di hadapannya, dia nampak lampu fost yang terang sebagai satu-satunya sumber cahaya dalam bilik itu, dan di sebelahnya, empat mangkuk adunan yang semuanya kelihatan kemerahan dengan sesuatu di dalamnya yang tidak dapat dilihatnya dengan jelas. Di dalam setiap mangkuk adunan ada sesuatu yang logam dan tebal. Tiga daripada benda logam tebal ini dipenuhi campuran kemerahan yang sama.

ae0cdf221e9b.en: Eori threw the empty mug on the wall across from Harry, making a loud bang that sounded like a shotgun had gone off. “FUCK OFF! YOU’RE THE ONE WHO’S SUPPOSED TO MAKE THIS SHIT EASIER! I’m not getting any results, and now I have to fucking babysit you too!” She then took what appeared to be a salt shaker and shook it into the fost lamp, bringing it back to life and brightening up the room. “Don’t you fucking dare!” With a sneer plastered on her face, she slumped forward by Harry and picked up the wooden bucket that smelled strongly of piss. With a large groan, she strained her face and lifted the bucket towards the sink. Removing the stopper from the sink, she dumped the piss down the drain and doused vinegar into both to curb the piss stench. Placing the empty bucket back where it was, she added the end tube of Harry’s pee cup back into it. “Don’t you fucking dare shit on me again!”
ae0cdf221e9b.t: Eori mencampakkan kole kosong itu ke dinding bertentangan dengan Harry, membuatkan dentuman kuat yang kedengaran seperti senapang patah meletup. “PERGI JAHANAM! KAU YANG SEPATUTNYA BUAT BENDA CELAKA NI LEBIH SENANG! Aku tak dapat apa-apa keputusan, dan sekarang aku kena jaga kau macam budak juga, celaka!” Dia kemudian mengambil sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti bekas garam dan menggoncangnya ke dalam lampu fost, menghidupkannya semula dan menerangkan bilik itu. “Jangan berani, celaka!” Dengan cebikan terpalit di wajahnya, dia membongkok ke depan di sebelah Harry dan mengangkat baldi kayu yang berbau kencing yang kuat. Dengan erangan besar, dia menegangkan wajahnya dan mengangkat baldi itu ke arah sinki. Menanggalkan penyumbat dari sinki, dia membuang kencing itu ke dalam longkang dan menuang cuka ke dalam kedua-duanya untuk mengurangkan bau busuk kencing. Meletakkan baldi kosong itu semula di tempatnya, dia memasukkan semula hujung tiub cawan kencing Harry ke dalamnya. “Jangan berani berak atas aku lagi, celaka!”

b01916843d0c.en: Harry closed his eyes and curled up his body as the memories of what had happened poured in. His heart began racing so loudly, he could feel it pounding on the back of his head like he had a migraine. In the darkness of his vision, he could feel glimpses of being in a dark forest, running away from those same exact noises. The imminence of death and despair played with his heart as he could nearly feel an arrow stuck in his trachea while the warm blood poured down his throat, warming his chest as if he had a warm, cozy blanket resting on him. He gasped as he opened his eyes, trying to escape that feeling. He saw Eori putting the bow away, and with short, shallow breaths, he looked down at his own body. The arrow was snapped in pieces, lying on the floor to his left—probably after hitting the same hard wall Harry was chained to.
b01916843d0c.t: Harry memejamkan mata dan meringkukkan tubuhnya ketika ingatan tentang apa yang telah berlaku mencurah masuk. Jantungnya mula berlumba begitu kuat, dia dapat merasakannya berdebar di belakang kepalanya seperti dia diserang migrain. Dalam kegelapan penglihatannya, dia dapat merasakan sekilas berada dalam hutan gelap, melarikan diri dari bunyi-bunyi yang sama betul. Kematian yang menghampiri dan keputusasaan bermain dengan hatinya kerana dia hampir dapat merasakan anak panah tersekat dalam trakeanya sementara darah hangat mencurah ke kerongkongnya, menghangatkan dadanya seolah-olah dia mempunyai selimut hangat yang selesa di atasnya. Dia tercungap ketika membuka matanya, cuba melarikan diri dari perasaan itu. Dia melihat Eori menyimpan busur itu, dan dengan nafas pendek dan cetek, dia memandang ke bawah ke tubuhnya sendiri. Anak panah itu patah berkecai, terbaring di lantai di sebelah kirinya—mungkin selepas mengenai dinding keras yang sama tempat Harry dirantai.

b1b1ac8506da.en: “Open your mouth!” Eori said as she shoved a hefty dose of black honey down his gullet, nearly feeding him the same way farmers do to geese to fatten them up for some deliciously buttery rich foie gras.
b1b1ac8506da.t: “Buka mulut kau!” Eori berkata sambil menyumbat sedos besar madu hitam ke kerongkongnya, hampir menyuapnya dengan cara yang sama seperti petani memberi makan angsa untuk menggemukkannya bagi foie gras yang lazat, berlemak dan kaya.

b25266a88bfe.en: A mixture of gag, cough, and breath all kept trying to happen simultaneously, but there was only one pipe to share all of those actions—a classical race condition. Despite wanting to breathe, Harry felt like his only action was to hold in the urge to breathe and swallow this diabetes-inducing sloppy grainy, thick paste with a big forceful gulp.
b25266a88bfe.t: Campuran rasa nak muntah, batuk dan nafas semuanya terus cuba berlaku serentak, tetapi hanya ada satu paip untuk dikongsi oleh semua tindakan itu—keadaan perlumbaan yang klasik. Walaupun mahu bernafas, Harry merasakan satu-satunya tindakannya ialah menahan desakan untuk bernafas dan menelan pes pekat berbutir yang selekeh dan boleh menyebabkan kencing manis ini dengan satu teguk paksa yang besar.

b2e86b191495.en: “What else? What’s the last thing you remember?” Eori’s interviewer mood kicked into high gear again.
b2e86b191495.t: “Apa lagi? Apa benda terakhir yang kau ingat?” Mood penemu duga Eori kembali ke gear tinggi.

b32df4dcae08.en: Eori ignored his feet kicking her thigh and crotch, at least at first. “Fucking stop it!” The more Harry struggled, the more her smile disappeared, leaving behind eyes seething with acute anger. She squeezed Harry’s neck with all her revengeful might, now truly squeezing his life out. She shook it violently, screaming in his face, “ANSWER THE FUCKING QUESTION!”
b32df4dcae08.t: Eori tidak mengendahkan kakinya yang menendang peha dan celah kangkangnya, sekurang-kurangnya pada mulanya. “Berhentilah, celaka!” Semakin Harry meronta, semakin hilang senyumannya, meninggalkan mata yang mendidih dengan kemarahan yang tajam. Dia memicit leher Harry dengan sepenuh kekuatan dendamnya, kini benar-benar memerah nyawanya keluar. Dia menggoncangnya dengan ganas, menjerit di mukanya, “JAWAB SOALAN CELAKA TU!”

b45efbbaa16d.en: With his sphincter tightening up, Harry did all he could to prevent that. Although, not like he had anything on the tank either—a benefit of a diet consisting of nothing but black honey. His eyes were bothered by the brighter light, but he kept on silently trying to follow along with what Eori was doing, now seeing her gruntle as she struggled to remove what appeared to be a barrel from underneath the sink, put a cork on the top hole, then continually scratch it on the floor as she kept pushing it closer to the stairs.
b45efbbaa16d.t: Dengan sfinkternya mengetat, Harry melakukan segala yang dia mampu untuk mencegahnya. Walaupun, bukannya ada apa-apa dalam tangki pun—manfaat diet yang tidak lain hanyalah madu hitam. Matanya terganggu oleh cahaya yang lebih terang, tetapi dia terus cuba dalam diam mengikuti apa yang Eori lakukan, kini melihatnya merungut sambil bergelut mengeluarkan sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti tong dari bawah sinki, meletakkan gabus pada lubang atas, kemudian terus menggaruknya di lantai sambil terus menolaknya mendekati tangga.

b72d87dbbd5b.en: “Dammit—which variant of thirty-seven I used that day?” Eori spoke under her breath, rapidly flipping through the pages in her girly pink journal.
b72d87dbbd5b.t: “Sial—varian tiga puluh tujuh mana yang aku guna hari tu?” Eori bercakap perlahan, menyelak halaman jurnal merah jambunya yang keanak-gadisan dengan pantas.

bc46639fd4de.en: From clouding darkness enveloping his senses, Harry felt a touch of a soft palm on his skinless chest. A burning, itchy sensation came into his flayed flesh as his left eye saw Eori unclenching her fingers, scraping her nails in his flesh, firmly holding her palm against his chest.
bc46639fd4de.t: Dari kegelapan berkabus yang menyelubungi derianya, Harry merasakan sentuhan tapak tangan yang lembut di dadanya yang tidak berkulit. Sensasi pedih dan gatal datang ke dalam dagingnya yang dilapah ketika mata kirinya melihat Eori membuka genggaman jarinya, menggaru kukunya ke dalam dagingnya, memegang tapak tangannya dengan kuat pada dadanya.

bcd904e115fa.en: A cackle sounded in the room. “How did that feel?” Long-haired Harry placed her girly pajamas in front of her, hiding her manly looking nipples.
bcd904e115fa.t: Ketawa terkekeh-kekeh kedengaran dalam bilik. “Macam mana rasanya?” Harry berambut panjang meletakkan piyama keanak-gadisannya di hadapannya, menyembunyikan putingnya yang kelihatan jantan.

bd1ec03f8587.en: Harry repeated after her, but nothing happened—not even doing with the other hand or both hands.
bd1ec03f8587.t: Harry mengulanginya, tetapi tiada apa-apa berlaku—tidak juga dengan tangan yang lagi satu atau kedua-dua tangan.

bf3f7f732dad.en: Harry felt the long-hair version of himself getting awfully close to him; he could nearly feel and smell her manly bits about to touch his face. He clenched himself even more, waiting for the worst, but then he felt something happening to one of his wrists. A clacking sound followed by his numb left arm falling limp by his side made a sharp pain go up his shoulder. The other arm now held his entire weight, dislocating it from his shoulder. With another clack, his body was released, and he crashed onto the ground like a disembodied ragdoll. A prickling sensation took over his hands, going up to his forearms, while his shoulders and back felt tender and weak.
bf3f7f732dad.t: Harry merasakan versi dirinya yang berambut panjang semakin dekat dengannya; dia hampir dapat merasakan dan menghidu anggota jantannya hendak menyentuh mukanya. Dia mengetatkan dirinya lebih lagi, menunggu yang paling teruk, tetapi kemudian dia merasakan sesuatu berlaku pada salah satu pergelangan tangannya. Bunyi berdetak diikuti lengan kirinya yang kebas terkulai di sisinya membuatkan kesakitan tajam naik ke bahunya. Lengan yang lagi satu kini menampung seluruh beratnya, terkehel dari bahunya. Dengan satu lagi detak, tubuhnya dilepaskan, dan dia terhempas ke lantai seperti anak patung kain yang tidak bernyawa. Sensasi mencucuk-cucuk mengambil alih tangannya, naik ke lengan bawahnya, manakala bahu dan belakangnya terasa lembut sakit dan lemah.

c05022504ef2.en: Harry reacted poorly, letting the sigil ring fall on the floor near his feet. Picking it up, he saw a familiar two-finger hole on the back and a large plaque in front, but the logograms on the plaque looked different; one was four stacked horizontally curved lines, while the other was a plus sign. This is not Body Restore—something plus? Wait! Water Create? Harry saw the writing on the back plate. Ohhhh. I get it now. Remembering how Eiri used Body Restore to heal him, he wore the ring on his right middle and ring fingers, then with the same hand, he tried to clench the fingers while leaving the palm exposed. Wait—is that right?
c05022504ef2.t: Harry bertindak balas dengan teruk, membiarkan cincin sigil itu jatuh ke lantai berhampiran kakinya. Mengambilnya, dia melihat lubang dua jari yang biasa di belakang dan plak besar di depan, tetapi logogram pada plak itu kelihatan berbeza; satu ialah empat garis melengkung mendatar yang bertindan, manakala satu lagi tanda tambah. Ini bukan Body Restore—sesuatu tambah? Kejap! Water Create? Harry melihat tulisan pada plat belakang. Ohhhh. Sekarang aku faham. Teringat bagaimana Eiri menggunakan Body Restore untuk menyembuhkannya, dia memakai cincin itu pada jari tengah dan jari manis kanannya, kemudian dengan tangan yang sama, dia cuba mengepal jari sambil membiarkan tapak tangan terdedah. Kejap—betul ke ni?

c241043b732d.en: Vol 2 Chapter III subchapter 5: Harry, chained and bearded, looks over at the purple-haired woman working at a cluttered table.
c241043b732d.t: Jilid 2 Bab III subbab 5: Harry, dirantai dan berjanggut, memandang wanita berambut ungu yang bekerja di meja yang bersepah.

c2c39fca6828.en: Harry felt a sinking feeling—perhaps his fate was sealed the moment he awoke in that tower.
c2c39fca6828.t: Harry merasakan perasaan tenggelam—mungkin nasibnya sudah termeterai sejak saat dia tersedar di menara itu.

c40e1bf655cf.en: Eori jotted down something in the journal, sighing heavily as she softly chewed the winga feather. She seemed lost in thought for a mere moment, at least until she threw the feather on the table and blurted out, “You know what? Fuck it! I give up on thirty-seven.” She waved the journal to let the ink dry, then closed and shoved it on the smaller bookcase hanging on the wall above her.
c40e1bf655cf.t: Eori mencatat sesuatu dalam jurnal, mengeluh berat sambil mengunyah perlahan bulu winga itu. Dia kelihatan tenggelam dalam fikiran seketika, sekurang-kurangnya sehingga dia mencampakkan bulu itu ke atas meja dan terlepas cakap, “Kau tahu apa? Lantaklah! Aku putus asa dengan tiga puluh tujuh.” Dia mengibas jurnal itu untuk membiarkan dakwat kering, kemudian menutup dan menyumbatnya ke rak buku yang lebih kecil yang tergantung di dinding di atasnya.

c42f845c716f.en: After cleaning the basement with Eori, with him doing all the grunt work, she brought him to where he was now. He looked in front of him, towards the slanted walls of an unknown bathroom, on the second floor of a house he had never seen before. In his peripheral vision, he could see manly bits hanging. Looking down at his own, it looked like a clone, as even the right-slant crook was there too. In his lap, his arms rested with pieces of hair and dried blood dirtying his skin, while his wrists were shackled by a robust chain that was tight but not too tight as to hurt him. His feet also suffered the same fate, ensuring he wouldn’t get far if he were to escape. I guess at least I’m no longer hanging from the wall?
c42f845c716f.t: Selepas membersihkan bilik bawah tanah dengan Eori, dengan dia melakukan semua kerja kasar, Eori membawanya ke tempat dia berada sekarang. Dia memandang ke hadapannya, ke arah dinding condong sebuah bilik air yang tidak dikenali, di tingkat dua sebuah rumah yang tidak pernah dilihatnya sebelum ini. Dalam penglihatan pinggirnya, dia dapat melihat anggota jantan tergantung. Memandang ke bawah ke miliknya sendiri, ia kelihatan seperti klon, malah bengkok condong ke kanan pun ada juga. Di ribanya, lengannya terletak dengan cebisan rambut dan darah kering mengotorkan kulitnya, manakala pergelangan tangannya dibelenggu oleh rantai yang kukuh yang ketat tetapi tidak terlalu ketat sehingga menyakitkannya. Kakinya juga mengalami nasib yang sama, memastikan dia tidak akan pergi jauh jika dia melarikan diri. Rasanya sekurang-kurangnya aku tak tergantung kat dinding lagi?

c6a60e5a7699.en: Feeling his mouth violated by a large spoon, Harry’s throat demanded a gag in response.
c6a60e5a7699.t: Merasakan mulutnya dicabul oleh sudu besar, kerongkong Harry menuntut rasa nak muntah sebagai tindak balas.

c6d2d94e6822.en: With another grunt as his inner organs begged for mercy, Harry’s brain went blank as a surging wave of cold sweat hit him, making him look pale. “What—what—do you—want from me?”
c6d2d94e6822.t: Dengan satu lagi rengusan ketika organ dalamannya merayu belas kasihan, otak Harry menjadi kosong ketika gelombang peluh sejuk yang melonjak menghentamnya, membuatkannya kelihatan pucat. “Apa—apa—yang awak—nak dari saya?”

c77d119efa2b.en: Meanwhile, Eori’s hands were full. One hand carried a tantalizing half-bitten sandwich that had red and purple meat contrasting the hearty amount of leafy greens. On the other, it was a mug with a blackish liquid. She finished the sandwich as she approached Harry and lifted the mug towards his mouth.
c77d119efa2b.t: Sementara itu, tangan Eori penuh. Sebelah tangan membawa sandwic separuh digigit yang menggoda dengan daging merah dan ungu yang kontras dengan sayur-sayuran berdaun yang banyak. Di sebelah lagi, sebiji kole dengan cecair kehitaman. Dia menghabiskan sandwic itu ketika mendekati Harry dan mengangkat kole itu ke mulutnya.

c98adf1119e8.en: Harry looked down and had a jerking reaction. Somehow seeing that there wasn’t a massive syringe poking his belly button, and it wasn’t bleeding either, just felt incredibly weird—as if it was still there even though he saw Eori putting the syringe back on the table. His brain jolted again, now telling him his chest was being cut apart even though his eyes saw it had already happened. “Why? Why—” Harry froze with his mouth open for a few seconds. “Eori? Please! I didn’t do anything!” His droopy voice spoke pleadingly, with the scalpel pain kicking in, bothering him like a paper cut.
c98adf1119e8.t: Harry memandang ke bawah dan tersentak. Entah bagaimana melihat bahawa tiada picagari besar yang mencucuk pusatnya, dan ia tidak berdarah juga, terasa sangat pelik—seolah-olah ia masih ada walaupun dia melihat Eori meletakkan picagari itu semula di atas meja. Otaknya tersentak lagi, kini memberitahunya dadanya sedang dihiris walaupun matanya melihat ia sudah berlaku. “Kenapa? Kenapa—” Harry membeku dengan mulut terbuka selama beberapa saat. “Eori? Tolonglah! Saya tak buat apa-apa!” Suaranya yang layu bercakap merayu, dengan kesakitan pisau bedah mula terasa, mengganggunya seperti luka kertas.

cacca08b11e8.en: The memory of flesh being scooped out of him came back to mind, and with it, the pain. He remained silent as his body tensed up. Suddenly, Arukia came to his mind. Maybe I am from Tolerideme? She did say I reminded her of them!
cacca08b11e8.t: Ingatan daging dikorek keluar daripadanya kembali ke fikiran, dan bersamanya, kesakitan. Dia kekal diam sementara tubuhnya menegang. Tiba-tiba, Arukia terlintas di fikirannya. Mungkin aku dari Tolerideme? Dia ada kata aku ingatkan dia pada mereka!

cd17caef109e.en: With an open mouth, Harry could not believe what his eyes were seeing; Eori’s clenched face and fists held back what had to be immense pain. She tilted her head back while her bloodshot eyes looked like someone let hungry rats trample through her insides. Ow fuck—is that? Harry saw Eori transforming into a copy of himself right before his eyes—he couldn’t see every detail of it, but she was undoubtedly turning into himself. The bone-crunching noises coming from her body sounded like a chiro was adjusting every bone at once. The flesh visibly moved beneath her skin as her hair turned black from the follicles in her scalp and down its length. Why is she doing that? Harry nearly felt like he was the one in pain, seeing a near-identical copy of himself reeve in agony—the only difference now being her long black hair.
cd17caef109e.t: Dengan mulut terbuka, Harry tidak dapat mempercayai apa yang dilihat matanya; wajah dan penumbuk Eori yang terkepal menahan sesuatu yang pasti kesakitan yang amat sangat. Dia mendongakkan kepalanya sementara matanya yang merah menyala kelihatan seperti seseorang melepaskan tikus-tikus kelaparan memijak-mijak isi perutnya. Alamak—itu ke? Harry melihat Eori berubah menjadi salinan dirinya betul-betul di depan matanya—dia tidak dapat melihat setiap butirannya, tetapi dia pasti sedang berubah menjadi dirinya. Bunyi tulang berderak dari tubuhnya kedengaran seperti seorang kiropraktor membetulkan setiap tulang serentak. Daging bergerak dengan ketara di bawah kulitnya sementara rambutnya bertukar hitam dari folikel di kulit kepalanya dan turun ke sepanjang rambutnya. Kenapa dia buat macam tu? Harry hampir merasakan seperti dialah yang sedang kesakitan, melihat salinan dirinya yang hampir serupa menggeliat dalam keperitan—satu-satunya perbezaan kini ialah rambut hitamnya yang panjang.

cd8a3aff4e4c.en: With his left eye, Harry saw her carefully slice the scoops of his carved flesh as if he had just placed a special order to the butcher, and he was standing there, waiting for it while thinking of what to cook for sides to pair up with his mouthwatering meat. IT HURTS! Harry meandering hyperphantasia of a summer cookout was hindered by what he felt like a rat was let loose inside his right eye socket, trying to scratch its way out. He felt a moistness develop in the area as a sharp, throbbing, shocking pain made him want to shriek like a rageful primate. He felt his lungs filling up and his vocal cords ready to scream until they tore up, but at the last second, his mind held back that urge with another internal guttural scream that half-escaped through his nose. The thought of Eori flipping her shit and making his pain worse was more than enough to force him to contain it all back.
cd8a3aff4e4c.t: Dengan mata kirinya, Harry melihatnya dengan berhati-hati menghiris sudu-sudu dagingnya yang diukir seolah-olah dia baru membuat pesanan istimewa kepada tukang daging, dan dia berdiri di situ, menunggunya sambil memikirkan hidangan sampingan untuk dipadankan dengan dagingnya yang menyelerakan. SAKIT! Hiperfantasia Harry yang melayang tentang barbeku musim panas terganggu oleh apa yang dirasakannya seperti seekor tikus dilepaskan di dalam soket mata kanannya, cuba mencakar keluar. Dia merasakan kelembapan terbentuk di kawasan itu ketika kesakitan yang tajam, berdenyut dan mengejutkan membuatkannya mahu menjerit seperti primat yang mengamuk. Dia merasakan paru-parunya terisi dan peti suaranya bersedia untuk menjerit sehingga koyak, tetapi pada saat terakhir, fikirannya menahan desakan itu dengan satu lagi jeritan dalaman dari kerongkong yang separuh terlepas melalui hidungnya. Fikiran tentang Eori mengamuk dan memburukkan kesakitannya lebih daripada cukup untuk memaksanya memendam semuanya.

ce63ed9fdb2c.en: Vol 2 Chapter IV subchapter 1: a long-haired person, seen from behind, shaves the face of a scarred man sitting in an attic room.
ce63ed9fdb2c.t: Jilid 2 Bab IV subbab 1: seseorang berambut panjang, dilihat dari belakang, mencukur muka seorang lelaki berparut yang duduk di bilik loteng.

ceab412767ee.en: Something clicked in Harry’s brain; looking at the nari gel of his own flesh, he said, “Wait—are you selling me? Like—people to look like me?” With a gasp, he continued, raising his voice, “Is this how I am repaying my debt? But—”
ceab412767ee.t: Sesuatu terlintas dalam otak Harry; memandang nari gel daripada dagingnya sendiri, dia berkata, “Kejap—awak jual saya ke? Macam—orang untuk nampak macam saya?” Dengan tercungap, dia menyambung, meninggikan suaranya, “Ini ke cara saya bayar hutang saya? Tapi—”

cfaff378d604.en: They are now talking with a fake you. Eori’s voice from before surfaced in Harry’s mind, making a chill run down his bones. “This is for the fake me!”
cfaff378d604.t: Mereka sekarang bercakap dengan kau yang palsu. Suara Eori dari tadi muncul dalam fikiran Harry, membuatkan kesejukan menjalar ke tulangnya. “Ini untuk saya yang palsu!”

d2224e43e973.en: The same usual feeling of drinking a gallon of coffee rushed in, getting rid of any grogginess—if he was even sleeping before. Harry felt his adrenaline peak, giving his screaming-in-pain wrists a fighting chance to break free from being forced to support his entire body weight. “WHAT? WHAT DID I DO?” The chains in his hand rustled and banged loudly against the wall as he tried to break free. His hanging feet decided to take action and kicked forward with all the strength he could muster—which wasn’t exactly much.
d2224e43e973.t: Perasaan biasa yang sama seperti minum segelen kopi menerpa masuk, menyingkirkan sebarang rasa mamai—kalau dia memang tidur sebelum itu. Harry merasakan adrenalinanya memuncak, memberikan pergelangan tangannya yang menjerit kesakitan peluang untuk melawan supaya bebas dari dipaksa menampung seluruh berat badannya. “APA? APA YANG SAYA BUAT?” Rantai di tangannya bergemerincing dan berdentam kuat pada dinding ketika dia cuba melepaskan diri. Kakinya yang tergantung memutuskan untuk bertindak dan menendang ke depan dengan sepenuh kekuatan yang mampu dikumpulnya—yang tidaklah banyak.

d387de16c4f7.en: “And now?” A scientific glint emerged in Eori’s eyes as the same vicious smile began rising on her face.
d387de16c4f7.t: “Dan sekarang?” Sinar saintifik muncul di mata Eori ketika senyuman ganas yang sama mula timbul di wajahnya.

d46558a6720a.en: “What else?” Eori’s voice sounded feminine, but the probing tone sounded like a yandere girl suspecting her boyfriend was cheating.
d46558a6720a.t: “Apa lagi?” Suara Eori kedengaran feminin, tetapi nada mendesaknya kedengaran seperti gadis yandere yang mengesyaki teman lelakinya curang.

d46cad53c728.en: Without a flinch, Harry felt one of Eori’s hands move towards his throat while the other did something he couldn’t see. “M—my head hurts—”
d46cad53c728.t: Tanpa tersentak, Harry merasakan sebelah tangan Eori bergerak ke arah kerongkongnya sementara tangan yang lagi satu melakukan sesuatu yang tidak dapat dilihatnya. “Ke—kepala saya sakit—”

d6af2777453d.en: Harry suddenly awakened to a tight grip around his neck. He inhaled air with a guttural sound, trying to fill his lungs.
d6af2777453d.t: Harry tiba-tiba tersedar dengan cengkaman kuat di lehernya. Dia menyedut udara dengan bunyi dari kerongkong, cuba memenuhi paru-parunya.

d80a6fd44633.en: Looking down, the same jolting feeling appeared as his brain tried to cope with an apparent dissonant reality; his torso was healed while his gut was sliced open vertically. His innards poked through the wound, curiously wanting to plop out. However, he only still felt his chest being itchy—it was like he was in VR watching somebody else’s body being messed with.
d80a6fd44633.t: Memandang ke bawah, perasaan tersentak yang sama muncul ketika otaknya cuba menghadapi realiti yang nampaknya sumbang; badannya sudah sembuh sementara perutnya terhiris terbuka secara menegak. Isi perutnya menjengul melalui luka itu, ingin tahu mahu terjatuh keluar. Namun, dia masih hanya merasakan dadanya gatal—ia seperti dia berada dalam VR menonton tubuh orang lain diusik.

df9bde77c5ad.en: “SHUT UP!” Eori’s scream echoed in the room as she stomped towards a cabinet under the stairs, opening and taking out a crossbow.
df9bde77c5ad.t: “DIAM!” Jeritan Eori bergema dalam bilik ketika dia menghentak kaki ke arah kabinet di bawah tangga, membukanya dan mengeluarkan busur silang.

e4a430899bbb.en: With his eyes still tightly shut and his head trying to disappear into his neck, Harry just responded with a dissonant hum—the winking butthole still corrupted his imagination.
e4a430899bbb.t: Dengan matanya masih terpejam rapat dan kepalanya cuba hilang ke dalam lehernya, Harry hanya menjawab dengan dengungan sumbang—lubang punggung yang mengenyit itu masih mencemarkan imaginasinya.

e4d4ffa68983.en: “You fucking mute or what? I don’t have all day!” Eori picked a dirty knife from the same table and pointed towards Harry.
e4d4ffa68983.t: “Kau bisu ke apa, celaka? Aku tak ada masa sepanjang hari!” Eori mengambil sebilah pisau kotor dari meja yang sama dan menghalakannya ke arah Harry.

e6169c864fc7.en: Meanwhile, the cold liquid deposited deep inside him felt like it had sand on it, hurting his insides if he moved slightly, even if he was taking a deeper breath. Unlike that night, he didn’t feel his senses tingling. He didn’t seem to be feeling anything—at least not at first. Maybe, just maybe, there was something different—like that odd feeling where you don’t know if you are high or not right after inhaling something of dubious quality.
e6169c864fc7.t: Sementara itu, cecair sejuk yang dimasukkan jauh di dalamnya terasa seperti ada pasir di dalamnya, menyakitkan isi dalamannya jika dia bergerak sedikit, walaupun jika dia menarik nafas yang lebih dalam. Tidak seperti malam itu, dia tidak merasakan derianya kesemutan. Dia nampaknya tidak merasakan apa-apa—sekurang-kurangnya pada mulanya. Mungkin, hanya mungkin, ada sesuatu yang berbeza—seperti perasaan aneh di mana kau tidak tahu sama ada kau khayal atau tidak sejurus selepas menghidu sesuatu yang kualitinya meragukan.

e65cc39683da.en: He saw a clear vision of the enchanting crowd roaring as he tried to drive the knife into Maiara’s belly while his body barely held it together, only to see a flash of her legs coming rushing to his neck, sharply ending it all. “Before Maiara kicked me and—I died,” Harry spoke quietly as a sinking feeling came stronger in his chest.
e65cc39683da.t: Dia melihat penglihatan yang jelas tentang orang ramai yang memukau mengaum ketika dia cuba menikam pisau ke perut Maiara sementara tubuhnya hampir tidak dapat bertahan, hanya untuk melihat kilasan kakinya meluru ke lehernya, menamatkan semuanya dengan tajam. “Sebelum Maiara tendang saya dan—saya mati,” Harry bercakap perlahan sementara perasaan tenggelam semakin kuat di dadanya.

e70e114fc6f6.en: “Try again!” Eori came closer, crossed her arms, tapping her feet, carefully watching over Harry. A slightly annoyed frown began turning into a suspicious squint, then a slightly vicious smile formed.
e70e114fc6f6.t: “Cuba lagi!” Eori mendekat, memeluk tubuh, mengetuk-ngetuk kakinya, memerhati Harry dengan teliti. Kerutan yang sedikit jengkel mula bertukar menjadi kecilan mata yang curiga, kemudian senyuman yang sedikit ganas terbentuk.

ea0f895730ca.en: Vol 2 Chapter III subchapter 6: the purple-haired woman touches the bloodied chest of the chained Harry with a glowing hand.
ea0f895730ca.t: Jilid 2 Bab III subbab 6: wanita berambut ungu menyentuh dada Harry yang dirantai dan berlumuran darah dengan tangan yang bercahaya.

eba92e46d64c.en: “Argh—why the fuck didn’t Mom tell me I had to do all this shit too!” Eori kicked the barrel against the wall near the stairs, then proceeded to place a new empty barrel underneath the sink. “I’M SO FUCKING DONE!” She carefully washed her hand by sliding up the handle of a barrel above the sink—even cleaning in between the fingers and the wrist, too, like she were trying to avoid the plague or the next hot pandemic. Only a trickle of water came out from the handle rather than an angry gush. With sweat forming on her forehead, she gleaned back at Harry’s feeble gaze. “What the fuck do you want? I’m busy.”
eba92e46d64c.t: “Argh—kenapa celaka Bonda tak bagi tahu aku yang aku kena buat semua benda celaka ni juga!” Eori menendang tong itu ke dinding berhampiran tangga, kemudian meletakkan tong kosong yang baru di bawah sinki. “AKU DAH MUAK GILA!” Dia mencuci tangannya dengan berhati-hati dengan menggelongsor naik pemegang sebuah tong di atas sinki—malah membersihkan di celah-celah jari dan pergelangan tangan juga, seperti dia cuba mengelak wabak atau pandemik hangat seterusnya. Hanya titisan air yang keluar dari pemegang itu dan bukannya curahan yang marah. Dengan peluh terbentuk di dahinya, dia mengerling kembali ke arah renungan lemah Harry. “Apa celaka yang kau nak? Aku sibuk.”

ee967e2c68fa.en: A silent Eori fed the spell using her other hand again, then released it into the bathtub, making the white flames clash and disappear into the back of her hand, coming out as water from her palm.
ee967e2c68fa.t: Eori yang diam menyuapkan jampi menggunakan tangannya yang lagi satu sekali lagi, kemudian melepaskannya ke dalam tab mandi, membuatkan api putih berlaga dan hilang ke belakang tangannya, keluar sebagai air dari tapak tangannya.

ef64a5cdaa6a.en: “Sorry—but I don’t—” The memory of that moment in the duel unlocked in his mind, growing vivid. Though exact details were vague, he could still hear the big metal-colored dice banging on the ground as the crowd eagerly awaited the results. “—something with white, blue—red too? Maiara did go on the first turn—I went on the second, before—”
ef64a5cdaa6a.t: “Maaf—tapi saya tak—” Ingatan saat itu dalam pertarungan terbuka dalam fikirannya, menjadi jelas. Walaupun butiran tepatnya samar, dia masih dapat mendengar dadu besar berwarna logam itu berdentang di tanah ketika orang ramai menunggu keputusan dengan tidak sabar. “—sesuatu dengan putih, biru—merah juga? Maiara memang dapat giliran pertama—saya dapat giliran kedua, sebelum—”

f1d119d0d6ac.en: “No, fuckwad!” Eori’s tone began to sound angrier as she finished corking three more nari gels. With the leftovers in the bowl not appearing enough to fill another nari gel, she grabbed a spoon and started scarfing it down into her mouth like a starving dog. Curling up her toes, she looked like she was holding her breath to swallow the whole thing down as quickly as possible. Banging the empty bowl back on the table, she wiped her mouth with a small towel. She then held herself on the table’s edge, grimacing towards Harry, her teeth dirty with red gel. She looked like she gagged, but it was probably a wet burp instead. She kept holding herself against the table as her body involuntarily twitched uncomfortably. A feminine grunt coming out of her began with her feminine voice but ended in a masculine voice, sounding pretty spot-on to Harry’s voice.
f1d119d0d6ac.t: “Bukan, bangang celaka!” Nada Eori mula kedengaran lebih marah ketika dia selesai menutup tiga lagi nari gel. Dengan baki di dalam mangkuk tidak kelihatan cukup untuk mengisi satu lagi nari gel, dia mengambil sudu dan mula melahapnya ke dalam mulutnya seperti anjing kelaparan. Meringkukkan jari kakinya, dia kelihatan seperti menahan nafas untuk menelan semuanya secepat mungkin. Menghentak mangkuk kosong itu kembali ke atas meja, dia mengesat mulutnya dengan tuala kecil. Dia kemudian berpaut pada tepi meja, menyeringai ke arah Harry, giginya kotor dengan gel merah. Dia kelihatan seperti hendak muntah, tetapi mungkin itu sendawa basah sebaliknya. Dia terus berpaut pada meja sementara tubuhnya kejang dengan tidak selesa tanpa sengaja. Rengusan wanita yang keluar daripadanya bermula dengan suara wanitanya tetapi berakhir dengan suara lelaki, kedengaran agak tepat dengan suara Harry.

f1e0b0df8fff.en: “Argh—we’re doing this again. What’s your name?” Eori, sounding like an interviewer, loosened her grip on Harry’s throat.
f1e0b0df8fff.t: “Argh—kita buat benda ni lagi. Siapa nama kau?” Eori, kedengaran seperti seorang penemu duga, melonggarkan cengkamannya pada kerongkong Harry.

f2af1cc663dd.en: Without saying a word, Harry opened his mouth and tilted his weighty head back like a baby bird in a nest. The blackish liquid tasted of black honey, mostly diluted in water. There were still clumps of it; some had to be pieces of honeycomb that nearly choked him as they slumped down his throat. The diabetic, nauseating taste was not there this time—maybe Eori had done something to it, or perhaps it was the only thing Harry had eaten or drunk in a while. “Thank—you—” The words quietly slumped out of his mouth.
f2af1cc663dd.t: Tanpa berkata sepatah pun, Harry membuka mulutnya dan mendongakkan kepalanya yang berat ke belakang seperti anak burung dalam sarang. Cecair kehitaman itu berasa madu hitam, kebanyakannya dicairkan dalam air. Masih ada ketulan-ketulannya; sesetengahnya pasti cebisan sarang lebah yang hampir mencekiknya ketika ia jatuh ke kerongkongnya. Rasa kencing manis yang memualkan tiada kali ini—mungkin Eori telah melakukan sesuatu padanya, atau mungkin itu satu-satunya benda yang Harry makan atau minum sejak sekian lama. “Terima—kasih—” Kata-kata itu terlepas perlahan dari mulutnya.

f412ac9b1432.en: “Don’t die on me yet.” Eori was washing her hands in the sink.
f412ac9b1432.t: “Jangan mati dulu.” Eori sedang mencuci tangannya di sinki.

f482f9667ed4.en: “You’re not that much of a retard after all! Eiri, Sora, Aurora, and even Itagiba think you’re still out there, wasting the kingdom’s resources with the Sanbi-eye role. Meanwhile, I’m simply putting you to better use.” Eori went back to her clothing on the floor, bending forward to grab it, showing Harry a view of her, or rather his, butthole—looking like it was done on purpose.
f482f9667ed4.t: “Kau tak la terencat sangat rupanya! Eiri, Sora, Aurora, malah Itagiba ingat kau masih kat luar sana, membazir sumber kerajaan dengan peranan Sanbi-eye. Sementara itu, aku cuma gunakan kau dengan lebih baik.” Eori kembali ke pakaiannya di lantai, membongkok ke depan untuk mengambilnya, menunjukkan kepada Harry pemandangan lubang punggungnya, atau lebih tepat lubang punggung lelaki itu—kelihatan seperti sengaja dilakukan.

f5e5b79a5dd1.en: Even though the knife was blurry in his eyes, he knew what it was and what would happen. However, the memory Eori just requested was kinda malformed in his brain. Even other memories were kinda in an odd state too, as if they were all behind closed doors, and he had to find them one by one—like that unknown weird feeling of self-discovery first thing in the morning, right after a night of heavy drinking where you don’t even know your name or where you are for a split second. With the anxious feeling inside him now frantically searching for his memories, pieces of his day began to surface again. “I-I—left Sanbi Castle with Sinoi?”
f5e5b79a5dd1.t: Walaupun pisau itu kabur di matanya, dia tahu apa itu dan apa yang akan berlaku. Namun, ingatan yang baru diminta Eori agak cacat dalam otaknya. Malah ingatan-ingatan lain juga dalam keadaan yang agak ganjil, seolah-olah semuanya di sebalik pintu-pintu tertutup, dan dia terpaksa mencarinya satu demi satu—seperti perasaan pelik penemuan diri yang tidak diketahui pada awal pagi, sejurus selepas malam minum berat di mana kau tidak tahu pun nama kau atau di mana kau berada untuk sesaat. Dengan perasaan resah dalam dirinya kini mencari ingatannya dengan kalut, kepingan-kepingan harinya mula muncul semula. “Sa-saya—tinggalkan Istana Sanbi dengan Sinoi?”

f65cbf05f4f3.en: Looking at it by accident, Harry’s mind went blank, and his face expressionless. He closed his eyes tightly, but the blurry image of his own butthole winking at him was burned in his retina and now in his memories.
f65cbf05f4f3.t: Terpandang secara tidak sengaja, fikiran Harry menjadi kosong, dan wajahnya tanpa ekspresi. Dia memejamkan matanya rapat-rapat, tetapi imej kabur lubang punggungnya sendiri yang mengenyit kepadanya terbakar di retinanya dan kini dalam ingatannya.

f6839c67c525.en: “Before what?” Eori checked for split ends on her hair, taking glances at Harry.
f6839c67c525.t: “Sebelum apa?” Eori memeriksa hujung rambutnya yang bercabang, mengerling ke arah Harry.

f71076fa9210.en: “I-I—don’t think so.” Harry glanced back at Eori. Crossing gazes with her attentive pinkish eyes staring him down. Wait—did Eiri tell Eori everything too? So they were working together! Feeling a void filling in his heart, he opened his mouth to just spill everything out—like a dying corpse soiling itself, “I still have these feelings that some things just don’t feel normal—like I thought they would look different—like that sink. I don’t think I’ve ever seen barrels used like that.” Harry squinted, trying to capture additional details of the sink’s appearance. “I don’t feel like I belong here—I’m sorry, but I just want to go home.”
f71076fa9210.t: “Sa-saya—rasanya tak.” Harry mengerling kembali ke arah Eori. Bertembung pandangan dengan mata merah jambunya yang penuh perhatian yang merenungnya. Kejap—Eiri bagi tahu Eori semuanya juga ke? Jadi mereka bekerjasama! Merasakan kekosongan memenuhi hatinya, dia membuka mulutnya untuk meluahkan segala-galanya—seperti mayat nazak yang mengotorkan dirinya, “Saya masih ada perasaan yang sesetengah benda tak terasa normal—macam saya ingat ia akan nampak lain—macam sinki tu. Saya rasa saya tak pernah nampak tong digunakan macam tu.” Harry mengecilkan matanya, cuba menangkap butiran tambahan rupa sinki itu. “Saya rasa saya tak sepatutnya berada kat sini—maaf, tapi saya cuma nak balik rumah.”

f9556fbfc3b7.en: Harry felt a jolt of energy coursing his insides, seeing the vicious grin forming on Eori as she grabbed the jars by her and walked to the macabre corner to store them away. The sinking feeling became a subdued terror as he saw Eori grab what appeared to be a short blade on her way back. His innards told him to run away, but his numbed hands, limping feet, and tired mind didn’t seem to want to partake in that rodeo of trying to escape again. “Please—can you not make it hurt so much?” He blurted out quietly.
f9556fbfc3b7.t: Harry merasakan sentakan tenaga mengalir dalam isi perutnya, melihat sengihan ganas terbentuk pada Eori ketika dia mengambil balang-balang di sebelahnya dan berjalan ke sudut mengerikan untuk menyimpannya. Perasaan tenggelam bertukar menjadi ketakutan yang terpendam ketika dia melihat Eori mengambil sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti bilah pendek dalam perjalanan kembali. Isi perutnya menyuruhnya lari, tetapi tangannya yang kebas, kakinya yang terkulai, dan fikirannya yang letih tidak kelihatan mahu menyertai pertunjukan cuba melarikan diri lagi. “Tolong—boleh tak awak jangan buat sakit sangat?” Dia terlepas cakap perlahan.

f9e7a11a0b6e.en: A significant shadow passed by, blocking the sun. Looking at it, Harry saw a big-ass bird gliding up high. Its blurry shape looked like a plane flying up high, but it was going too slow for it; plus the shape was not quite right. There are no plane trails at all—Harry felt that the sky was missing something he was accustomed to. Yeah—there’s supposed to be at least a few. A sinking feeling began emerging inside him. Maybe Tolerideme has them? But how do I even go there? Looking at the apparent endless forest, he sighed as he felt an itch coming from his chained wrists. I guess it doesn’t matter even if I find out where I am. I can’t remember my parents’ faces, let alone anybody else’s. But what if they recognize me instead? But how would I know?
f9e7a11a0b6e.t: Satu bayang yang besar berlalu, menghalang matahari. Memandangnya, Harry nampak seekor burung besar gila meluncur tinggi. Bentuknya yang kabur kelihatan seperti kapal terbang yang terbang tinggi, tetapi ia bergerak terlalu perlahan untuk itu; tambahan pula bentuknya tidak betul. Tak ada jejak kapal terbang langsung—Harry merasakan langit kekurangan sesuatu yang biasa baginya. Ha—sepatutnya ada sekurang-kurangnya beberapa. Perasaan tenggelam mula muncul dalam dirinya. Mungkin Tolerideme ada? Tapi macam mana aku nak pergi ke sana pun? Memandang hutan yang kelihatan tidak berpenghujung, dia mengeluh ketika merasakan gatal datang dari pergelangan tangannya yang dirantai. Rasanya tak penting pun kalau aku tahu aku kat mana. Aku tak ingat muka ibu bapa aku, apatah lagi muka orang lain. Tapi macam mana kalau mereka yang kenal aku? Tapi macam mana aku nak tahu?

fb5d45bcad9b.en: Harry froze in space and time—at least, that’s what it felt like. His mind was still full of thoughts, sensations, and worries, but he couldn’t process them. It felt like he had taken a massive hit from a dank bog, getting so unbelievably baked from the real sticky-icky-icky that his mind could only say Bruh.
fb5d45bcad9b.t: Harry membeku dalam ruang dan masa—sekurang-kurangnya, begitulah rasanya. Fikirannya masih penuh dengan fikiran, sensasi dan kebimbangan, tetapi dia tidak dapat memprosesnya. Ia terasa seperti dia telah menghisap sedutan besar dari bong yang hebat, menjadi begitu khayal tidak terkata akibat sticky-icky-icky yang sebenar sehingga fikirannya hanya boleh berkata Bruh.

fc574cf0b936.en: Nari gel? An agonizing pain struck Harry, seeing a scoop-sized chunk of meat and skin being flayed off his left triceps. Blood pooled from the wound and dripped down his armpit. In his mind, he saw Eori bursting into anger, making it far more painful if he fought back. “ARGH!” He contained the scream that slipped out his mouth to a loud grunt escaping his nose. He clenched his jaw tightly, nearly breaking his own teeth.
fc574cf0b936.t: Nari gel? Kesakitan yang menyeksakan menyerang Harry, melihat seketul daging dan kulit sebesar sesudu dilapah dari trisep kirinya. Darah berlopak dari luka itu dan menitis ke ketiaknya. Dalam fikirannya, dia melihat Eori meledak kemarahan, menjadikannya jauh lebih menyakitkan jika dia melawan. “ARGH!” Dia mengekang jeritan yang terlepas dari mulutnya menjadi rengusan kuat yang terlepas dari hidungnya. Dia mengetap rahangnya rapat-rapat, hampir mematahkan giginya sendiri.
